items.text: Lebanon's National News Agency reported an Israeli Merkava tank fired several shells at Khiam in southern Lebanon.

【佛山通報“教師招聘筆試前13名被淘汰，後5名進體檢”：多人被處理 將重新面試】近日，“佛山市季華中學2026年面向社會公開招聘編制教師的物理學科筆試成績前13名全部落選，後5名全部進入體檢名單”等相關情況，引起社會各界關注。8月19日，佛山市聯合調查組釋出情況通報：經研究，季華中學2026年8月5日面向社會公開招聘編制教師面試成績無效。佛山市將依法依規重新組織面試，對再次參加面試的考生給予交通、食宿補助。（央視新聞）
【寶信軟體：2026年半年度淨利潤7.07億元，同比微降0.81%】寶信軟體公告，2026年半年度營業收入56.32億元，同比增長19.45%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤7.07億元，同比下降0.81%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤6.74億元，同比增長0.60%。本報告期不進行利潤分配或公積金轉增股本。

【*ST清越：釋出第十六次重大違法強制退市風險提示】*ST清越公告稱，公司因涉嫌定期報告等財務資料虛假記載被中國證監會立案調查，於2026年5月8日收到《行政處罰事先告知書》，根據告知書認定情況，公司可能觸及科創板上市規則相關重大違法行為，可能被實施重大違法強制退市。若最終行政處罰決定書認定公司觸及重大違法強制退市情形，公司股票將自披露收到處罰決定書之日起停牌並被終止上市。截至本公告披露日，公司尚未收到正式處罰決定，將配合監管工作並履行資訊披露義務。

【長債重挫促使貝萊德等機構湧向短債，以免2022年的嚴重虧損重演】全球部分頭部投資機構正在湧向短期債券，他們正在對沖2022年情形的重演。自中東衝突爆發以來，貝萊德駐倫敦的James Turner已轉向期限較短的債券和通脹掛鉤債券；Aviva Investors、Aegon Asset Management和Allspring Global Investments則更青睞短期企業信貸，包括資產支援證券和私人債務。Allspring Global Investments投資組合經理Lauren van Biljon表示，相比長期政府債券，選擇包括信用債在內的短期限債券，可能是目前市場“共識最強的一項交易”，“而且效果也非常好”。
Interfax reported the Russian defence ministry said Russian forces have taken control of Vodyane in Ukraine's Donetsk region.

【*ST卓然：立案調查進展 或觸及重大違法強制退市】*ST卓然公告稱，公司及實際控制人張錦紅因涉嫌資訊披露違法違規等事項被中國證監會立案，現已初步查明公司披露的部分年度財務資訊涉嫌虛假記載，可能觸及重大違法強制退市情形。若後續經中國證監會行政處罰認定的事實觸及相關上市規則規定的重大違法強制退市情形，公司股票將被實施重大違法強制退市。截至本公告披露日，中國證監會的調查尚在進行中，公司將積極配合調查並履行資訊披露義務。
據訊息稱，EQT考慮作價5億美元出售越南教育資產。
俄羅斯國防部：俄軍已控制烏克蘭頓涅茨克地區的沃迪亞斯克。

【坤泰股份：股票交易異常波動 無應披露未披露事項】坤泰股份公告稱，公司股票於2026年8月17日、8月18日、8月19日連續3個交易日收盤價格跌幅偏離值累計超過20%，屬於股票交易異常波動情形。經核查，公司前期披露資訊無需更正補充，未發現對股價有較大影響的未公開重大資訊，近期經營情況及內外部經營環境未發生重大變化，公司、控股股東及實際控制人不存在應披露而未披露的重大事項，控股股東及實際控制人在異動期間未買賣公司股票。公司2026年上半年歸母淨利潤預計為300萬元—390萬元，目前無需修正業績預告。
【中國西電：2026年半年度淨利潤6.88億元，同比增長15.03%】中國西電公告，2026年上半年營業收入122.13億元，同比增長8.07%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤6.88億元，同比增長15.03%；歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤7.36億元，同比增長20.74%。公司擬向全體股東每10股派發現金紅利0.55元（含稅）。
【興業證券：2026年上半年淨利潤21.29億元，同比增長60.08%】興業證券公告，2026年上半年營業收入67.3億元，同比增長24.54%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤21.29億元，同比增長60.08%；扣非淨利潤20.8億元，同比增長61.39%。公司擬向全體股東每10股派送現金紅利0.5元（含稅）。
FOXCONN INDUSTRIAL repurchased 2.4144 million shares, using 149 million yuan.
【工業富聯：首次回購241.44萬股 耗資1.49億元】工業富聯(601138.SH)公告稱，公司於2026年8月19日透過集中競價交易方式首次回購股份241.44萬股，佔總股本0.01%，回購價格區間61.35元/股至61.97元/股，使用資金總額1.49億元。根據此前方案，公司擬以自有資金10億元至20億元回購股份，回購價格不超過103元/股，用於維護公司價值及股東權益。
德國檢方：一名涉及北溪管道案件的烏克蘭嫌疑人在克羅埃西亞被捕。嫌疑人涉嫌引發爆炸，破壞建築和結構。
【標普全球能源預計2026年美國光伏裝機增近三分之一 風電增近50%】標普全球能源預計，2026年美國新增光伏裝機將漲近三分之一、風電裝機將漲近50%。2027年，光伏裝機將再創新高，風電則會出現短暫回落，但之後幾年將再度回升。
Germany's prosecutors said a Ukrainian suspect linked to the Nord Stream pipeline investigation was arrested in Croatia on suspicion of triggering explosions and damaging buildings and structures.
迪拜數字經濟管理局（GDMO）：迪拜商會與NASSCOM簽署諒解備忘錄 推進代理式人工智慧領域合作。

A NATO official said Jordan's air-defence system intercepted ballistic missiles on four occasions launched from Iran toward Turkey, and that NATO's deterrence and defence posture is strong and effective.
訊息人士稱，義大利西雅那銀行董事會將於週四召開會議，討論抵禦聯合聖保羅銀行的防禦方案。
北約官員：我們的威懾和防禦態勢強大而有效。
北約官員：正如北約防空系統四次攔截從伊朗射向土耳其的彈道導彈時所展現的那樣。
【時代新材：2026年上半年淨利潤3.46億元，同比增14.08%】時代新材公告，2026年上半年營業收入104.67億元，同比增長13.09%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤3.46億元，同比增長14.08%；歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤3.12億元，同比增長33.91%。上年同期淨利潤3.03億元。公司擬向全體股東每10股派發現金股利人民幣0.90元（含稅）。
German prosecutors said another suspect has been arrested in connection with the Nord Stream pipeline explosions.
A NATO official, responding to reports that Iran may consider attacks on US targets in Europe, said NATO is prepared to respond to any threat and will take necessary measures to defend all allies.
日本首相高市早苗：將透過與美國等相關國家溝通，應對美國對國際刑事法院及赤根智子的制裁。

【紅果短劇：從未開展任何面向兒童的線下試鏡、選角、培訓收費等活動】8月19日，紅果短劇釋出關於警惕假冒紅果短劇開展兒童試鏡活動的宣告：近期，我們注意到有人冒充“紅果短劇”名義，以“兒童短劇試鏡”“線下選角”等為由釋出資訊、誘導聯絡，並以培訓費、簽約費等名目收取費用。紅果短劇鄭重宣告，平臺從未開展任何面向兒童的線下試鏡、選角、培訓收費等活動，凡以此類名義釋出的資訊、邀約或收費要求，均與紅果短劇無關，均屬冒充行為。

Bulgaria Current Account Swings to Deficit in June — Bulgaria’s current account shifted to a deficit of EUR 488.3 million in June 2026 from a surplus of EUR 199.8 million in the same month a year earlier. The deterioration was driven by a wider goods deficit of EUR 806.1 million, compared with EUR 490.3 million a year earlier, alongside a narrower services surplus of EUR 662.3 million versus EUR 1,061.7 million, reflecting weaker manufacturing and transportation services. As a result, the combined goods and services balance swung to a deficit of EUR 143.7 million from a surplus of EUR 571.4 million. Meanwhile, the primary income deficit narrowed slightly to EUR 454.5 million from EUR 456.1 million, while the secondary income surplus increased to EUR 109.9 million from EUR 84.5 million.
【捷捷微電：2026年半年度淨利潤2.98億元，同比增20.61%】捷捷微電公告，2026年半年度營業收入21.14億元，同比增長32.08%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤2.98億元，同比增長20.61%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤2.97億元，同比增長20.93%。公司計劃不派發現金紅利，不送紅股，不以公積金轉增股本。
北約官員就伊朗據稱考慮攻擊美國在歐洲目標一事表示：北約已準備好應對任何威脅，並將始終採取必要措施保衛所有盟國。
【睿能科技：2026年半年度淨利潤6571.59萬元，同比增長84.66%】睿能科技公告，2026年半年度營業收入15.63億元，同比增長38.01%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤6571.59萬元，同比增長84.66%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤6344.5萬元，同比增長91.46%。上年同期淨利潤3558.72萬元。本報告期利潤分配預案為無。
Market sources: Shell (SHEL.N) trader Mansfield has resigned after 26 years in the role.
【海螺水泥：8月19日回購76萬股A股股份】海螺水泥公告稱，公司於2026年8月19日透過上海證券交易所回購76萬股A股股份，佔回購前已發行股份（不含庫存股）的0.0193%，回購價格區間為每股17.43元-17.51元，成交總金額為1328.35萬元，所購股份擬持作庫存股份。本次回購後，公司已發行股份（不含庫存股）為39.44億股，庫存股份為3353.98萬股，已發行股份總數為39.77億股。
【璞泰來：2026年上半年淨利潤14.52億元，同比增長37.58%】璞泰來公告，2026年上半年營業收入101.15億元，同比增長42.70%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤14.52億元，同比增長37.58%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤13.12億元，同比增長32.25%。
Israel Defense Forces said it has sealed two sections of Hamas's underground tunnel network in Gaza totaling more than 2 km, as part of operations to degrade the network.
市場訊息：殼牌交易員曼斯菲爾德在這家石油巨頭任職26年後辭職。

【招商高速公路REIT：7月路費收入4348萬元 同比增12.4%】招商高速公路REIT公告稱，其底層資產安徽亳阜高速公路專案2026年7月日均收費車流量18533輛次，環比增長8.5%，同比增長18.5%；當月路費收入4348萬元，環比增長6.3%，同比增長12.4%。2026年累計日均收費車流量18140輛次，累計同比增長18.0%；累計路費收入2.94億元，累計同比增長14.6%。車流量及收入同比增長主因區域路網完善及引流效果顯現，環比增長主因7月收費天數更多且進入暑運高峰期。

【Russia says 103 prisoners exchanged with Ukraine】On the 19th (local time), the Russian Defence Ministry said it repatriated 103 Russian servicemen from Ukraine and, in exchange, handed over 103 Ukrainian prisoners to Ukrainian authorities.
【俄稱俄烏互換103名被俘人員】當地時間19日，據俄羅斯國防部訊息，俄方從烏克蘭接回103名俄羅斯軍人。作為交換，也向烏方移交了103名烏方被俘人員。（央視新聞）
【烏稱俄軍無人機襲擊赫爾松市一輛公交車 致4死5傷】烏克蘭總統澤連斯基19日在其官方社交平臺發文稱，俄軍19日早晨使用FPV無人機襲擊了烏克蘭赫爾松市一輛民用公交車，造成4人死亡、5人受傷。澤連斯基表示，相關救援部門已趕赴現場，目前正在核實具體情況。（央視新聞）

China-listed Invesco Nasdaq Technology ETF will halt trading from market open on Aug. 20, 2026 and is scheduled to resume at 10:30 local time the same day. Redemption requests will be processed normally during the suspension.
Al Jazeera, citing an Israeli broadcaster, reports a new poll shows Netanyahu-led Likud trailing Yesh Atid in voter support.
據Mysteel訊息，中儲糧週三售出30.8萬噸進口大豆，佔當日總成交量的85%。
Jiangsu Bank said H1 2026 operating income rose 9.11% YoY to 48.95 bln yuan, and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders rose 8.09% YoY to 21.88 bln yuan.

【五菱汽車：修正英文版第二段中淨利潤資料的文書錯誤】五菱汽車公告，公司就2026年8月18日釋出的盈利警告公告作出澄清，修正英文版第二段中淨利潤資料的文書錯誤。修正後，本集團截至2026年6月30日止六個月將錄得淨利潤約人民幣6300萬元，較2025年同期淨利潤人民幣8580.9萬元減少約27%；本公司擁有人應占利潤約人民幣2600萬元，較2025年同期人民幣3941.6萬元減少約34%。除上述修正外，該公告所有其他資料維持不變。

【鳳凰傳媒：2026年第二次臨時股東會選舉李貞強為董事】鳳凰傳媒公告稱，公司2026年第二次臨時股東會採用現場投票與網路投票相結合的方式召開，出席會議股東及股東代理人合計持有表決權股份19.61億股，佔公司有表決權股份總數的77.04%。會議審議透過《關於選舉公司董事的議案》，同意股數佔出席會議有效表決權股份總數的99.89%，李貞強當選為公司董事。本次股東會的召集召開程式、出席人員及召集人資格、表決程式及結果均合法有效。

【*ST網達：首次回購股份11.44萬股 耗資100.31萬元】*ST網達公告稱，公司透過集中競價交易方式首次回購股份11.44萬股，佔公司總股本的0.042%，回購價格區間為8.71元/股~8.83元/股，累計支付回購金額100.31萬元（不含交易費用）。本次回購為維護公司價值及股東權益所實施，回購方案預計回購金額2000萬元~3000萬元，回購價格不超過12元/股，實施期限為2026年7月21日至2026年10月20日。

【麒麟信安：股票交易異常波動 無應披露未披露重大事項】麒麟信安公告稱，公司股票連續3個交易日（2026年8月17日-8月19日）收盤價格漲幅偏離值累計超過30%，屬於股票交易異常波動。經自查併發函問詢控股股東及實控人，截至2026年8月19日，公司、控股股東及實控人均不存在應披露而未披露的重大資訊，董監高、控股股東及實控人在異常波動期間不存在買賣公司股票的情況。公司2025年營收3.10億元，淨虧損5807.42萬元；2026年一季度營收4123.44萬元，淨虧損862.72萬元，存在虧損風險，敬請投資者理性投資。
香港交易所CEO：在就交易時間調整作出任何決定前，將與市場進行溝通。科技、機器人和研發領域是IPO重點關注方向。IPO儲備仍然非常強勁。

HKEX CEO says any decision to alter trading hours will be preceded by consultation with market participants. Exchange is prioritizing IPOs in technology, robotics and R&D, and the IPO pipeline remains very strong.
【普元資訊：2026年半年度淨利潤虧損4503.9萬元】普元資訊公告，2026年半年度營業收入7619.87萬元，同比下降23.17%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤虧損4503.9萬元，上年同期淨利潤虧損2963.21萬元。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤虧損4849.12萬元。本報告期未進行利潤分配或公積金轉增股本。
【九華旅遊：2026年半年度淨利潤1.52億元，同比增長7.27%】九華旅遊公告，2026年半年度營業收入5億元，同比增長3.43%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤1.52億元，同比增長7.27%。扣非淨利潤1.49億元，同比增長7.51%。
【南京證券：國資集團間接控制股份比例增至39.11%】南京證券公告，公司於2026年8月19日收到實際控制人國資集團通知，南京市國資委將以2025年12月31日經審計的歸母淨資產為依據，將持有的城建集團、交通集團、東南集團股權注入國資集團。本次注入完成後，國資集團間接控制公司股份的比例將由28.83%增至39.11%，控股股東及實際控制人未發生變化。

【Iran warns any assistance to US forces will be treated as participation in military action against Iran】Iran’s armed forces chief of staff warned countries on the southern shore of the Persian Gulf not to facilitate US forces, saying any assistance to US troops would be treated as participation in military action against Iran. He said Tehran is closely monitoring US bases in the region and warned host countries against enabling US operations, adding that states claiming they would not allow the US to use their territory to strike Iran should know nothing escapes Tehran’s notice.

【奇瑞將在英國設立研發中心】奇瑞將在英國設立乘用車研發中心，進一步拓展英國市場業務。奇瑞國際英國公司執行長蓋瑞・蘭在週三的一份宣告中表示：“該研發中心是我們英國長期規劃的下一步。我們的目標絕不只是把汽車賣到英國。”奇瑞表示，該研發中心將於深秋正式投入運營。根據一份不具備法律約束力的諒解備忘錄，日產擬從明年開始，在桑德蘭工廠生產奇瑞集團的車型。這座全新研發中心選址貝德福德郡。該地區是工程技術與賽車運動產業聚集地，聚集多家汽車研發機構。研發工作將主要圍繞車輛適配英國本土路況開展，遠期還將覆蓋自動駕駛與人工智慧技術。奇瑞表示，計劃長期招聘本土人才，依託該研發中心創造大量高技能崗位。

【納斯達克ETF華安：二級市場交易價格溢價風險提示】納斯達克ETF華安公告稱，旗下華安納斯達克100交易型開放式指數證券投資基金（QDII）（基金程式碼：159632）二級市場交易價格明顯高於基金份額參考淨值，出現較大幅度溢價。2026年8月19日，該基金二級市場收盤價為2.436元，收盤時基金份額參考淨值為2.2668元。若2026年8月20日溢價幅度未有效回落，基金有權申請盤中臨時停牌、延長停牌時間及連續停牌等措施警示風險。目前基金運作正常，無應披露未披露重大資訊。

【McKinsey: Low UK food inflation unsustainable for retailers】McKinsey’s head of UK consumer business Bogdan Toma said UK food and beverage inflation has fallen to 1.3%, the weakest in about five years, a level he views as unsustainable for retailers operating on low-single-digit margins. He said retailers are absorbing a large share of rising costs amid weak consumer demand and price flattening, compressing margins and creating mounting tensions that need to be resolved. Toma added that hot weather and supply-chain disruptions for many farm products could put upward pressure on food prices this autumn.
【康佳集團股份有限公司原副總裁楊波被查】惠州清風官微8月19日通報，康佳集團股份有限公司原副總裁楊波涉嫌嚴重違紀違法，目前正接受中央紀委國家監委駐華潤集團紀檢監察組紀律審查和惠州市惠東縣監察委員會監察調查。

【奧普特：2026年上半年淨利潤1.7億元，同比增長16.78%】奧普特公告，2026年上半年營業收入9.04億元，同比增長32.46%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤1.7億元，同比增長16.78%。扣非淨利潤1.57億元，同比增長18.39%。公司擬每10股派發現金紅利2元（含稅）。

【華錫有色：2026年上半年營收30.39億元 淨利同比增39.81%】華錫有色公告稱，公司召開2026年半年度業績說明會，2026年上半年實現營業收入30.39億元，同比上升9.03%；歸母淨利潤5.34億元，同比上升39.81%。業績增長源於錫、銦等金屬價格上行，部分精礦產量提升及內部降本增效。目前高峰公司智慧礦山綜合管控平臺已全面投運，後續將持續推進數字化、智慧化改造，最佳化金屬綜合回收率，推進銅坑礦區錫鋅礦開發等重點專案。五吉公司、來冶公司資產注入工作正有序推進，同業競爭承諾履行期限已延期至2028年1月。

【之江生物：猴痘病毒核酸檢測試劑盒獲三類醫療器械註冊證】之江生物公告稱，公司猴痘病毒核酸檢測試劑盒（熒光PCR法）於近期獲得國家三類醫療器械註冊證，證書編號為國械注準20263401707，註冊證有效期為2026年8月17日至2031年8月16日，適用範圍為猴痘病毒核酸檢測，可在中國境內及認可NMPA的國家和地區使用。該產品獲證將豐富公司產品種類，完善分子診斷產品矩陣，提升市場競爭力，但其銷售額及利潤貢獻存在較大不確定性。

【神州細胞：控股子公司SCTB10注射液獲臨床試驗批准】神州細胞公告稱，公司控股子公司神州細胞工程有限公司收到國家藥監局核准簽發的《藥物臨床試驗批准通知書》，同意其自主研發的SCTB10注射液開展A型血友病的臨床試驗。SCTB10為重組抗FIXa/FX雙特異性抗體注射液，本次獲批開展的是評價該產品在健康志願者和血友病A患者中皮下給藥的I/II期臨床研究。該產品能否獲得上市許可及時間尚存在不確定性，預計短期內對公司經營業績不會產生大的影響。
【江蘇銀行：2026年上半年淨利潤218.76億元，同比增長8.09%】江蘇銀行公告，2026年上半年營業收入489.52億元，同比增長9.11%。歸屬於母公司股東的淨利潤218.76億元，同比增長8.09%。歸屬於母公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤218.04億元，同比增長8.10%。基本每股收益1.13元。

【匈牙利新當選總統鮑卡·安德拉什正式就職】根據憲法規定，匈牙利新當選的總統鮑卡·安德拉什當地時間19日正式就職總統。當地時間11日，匈牙利國會透過無記名投票方式選舉由執政黨蒂薩黨推選的鮑卡·安德拉什為匈牙利總統。共有146名國會議員參加投票，140票贊成，6票反對。（央視新聞）

【Keep自研Keepace.ai完成國家大模型備案，運動垂類AI加速落地】8月19日，運動科技公司Keep（03650.HK）自研運動健康大模型Keepace.ai完成國家及北京市大模型備案，備案編號為Beijing-KeepaceAI-202606250253。Keepace.ai於今年4月隨Keep App 9.0首次公佈，依託Keep十年積累的億級運動資料，並獲得首都體育學院運動健康領域專家團隊科學性支援。目前，該模型主要應用於訓練課程生成、運動知識問答和運動資料解讀，可結合使用者身體狀況、訓練目標、傷病史及運動資料提供個性化建議。Keep表示，未來將繼續投入AI研發和產品化，推動更多運動健康垂類AI能力落地，並探索新的商業化路徑。
【恆順醋業：2026年上半年淨利潤1.21億元，同比增長9.21%】恆順醋業公告，2026年上半年營業收入12.24億元，同比增長8.79%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤1.21億元，同比增長9.21%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤1.18億元，同比增長17.78%。基本每股收益0.11元。本報告期未進行利潤分配。

【華聯股份：累計回購股份佔總股本1.23%】華聯股份公告稱，截至2026年8月19日，公司透過集中競價交易方式累計回購股份3357.55萬股，佔公司總股本的1.23%，最高成交價1.48元/股，最低成交價1.29元/股，成交總金額為4669.39萬元（不含交易費用）。本次回購資金來源為自有資金，回購價格未超過方案擬定的2.23元/股的上限。公司回購股份方案為回購金額1億元至1.5億元，實施期限自2026年6月22日起3個月內，後續將繼續推進回購。

【奇瑞捷豹路虎新車被指官網套用蔚來ES8宣傳圖】8月18日，一位數碼博主發出影片稱，奇瑞捷豹路虎合作品牌FREELANDER神行者官網出現疑似蔚來ES8的白車身渲染圖，這張圖作為宣傳素材出現在品牌首發車型神行者8的頁面。根據該博主的影片，從這張圖片的白車身看，該圖片前機艙有一道橫樑，表明這是一個純電車型的白車身，無法佈局增程器。而A柱造型非常傾斜，也顯示圖中車輛並非方盒子的造型。記者從接近蔚來人士處確認，網傳神行者8官網白車身圖片確實為蔚來ES8的白車身圖。截至發稿時，神行者方面未對此事進行回應。（第一財經）

【Regulators order some private managers to self-check NAVs of specific funds】Local CSRC bureaus have issued self-inspection notices to private fund managers, focusing on disclosure accuracy and risk controls. 【盈方微：收購案獲經營者集中反壟斷審查透過】盈方微公告稱，公司擬以發行股份及支付現金的方式購買上海肖克利資訊科技股份有限公司100%股份並募集配套資金，近日收到國家市場監督管理總局出具的決定書，對本次收購股權案不實施進一步審查，公司可即日起實施集中。本次交易尚需履行深圳證券交易所稽核透過、中國證監會同意註冊等多項審批程式，能否透過審批及最終獲批時間尚存在不確定性。

Eurozone Inflation Confirmed at 2.9% in July — Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 2.9% in July 2026, in line with flash estimates, up from 2.8% in June and remaining well above the European Central Bank's 2.0% target, final data showed. The increase was largely driven by a renewed surge in energy prices, with energy inflation accelerating to 10.3% from 8.5% as hostilities between the US and Iran resumed. Underlying price pressures also strengthened. Services inflation edged up to 3.3% from 3.2%, while inflation for non-energy industrial goods rose to 0.9% from 0.7%. In contrast, food, alcohol, and tobacco inflation eased to 1.2% from 1.5%. The core inflation rate, which excludes energy and food, increased to 2.5% from 2.4%. Among the euro area's largest economies, inflation accelerated in Germany (2.8% vs 2.4%), France (2.4% vs 2.0%), Spain (3.9% vs 3.6%), and the Netherlands (3% vs 2.5%), while easing slightly in Italy (2.9% vs 3.0%).

【東帝汶總統奧爾塔會見董軍】東帝汶總統奧爾塔在帝力會見到訪的中國國防部長董軍。奧爾塔說，感謝中方自東帝汶獨立以來給予的長期支援和援助，希望兩軍進一步深化拓展務實合作。東帝汶堅定恪守一箇中國政策，反對任何國家干涉中國內政。南海問題應由當事國透過雙邊談判解決，東帝汶願同中國等地區各國一道，把南海打造成為和平、友誼、合作之海。董軍轉達習近平主席的親切問候，向東民族解放武裝力量紀念日致以誠摯祝賀。董軍說，兩國領導人就發展中東關係達成系列重要共識，推動雙邊關係邁入歷史最好時期。此次中國國防部長首次訪東，旨在深化兩軍戰略互信，提升防務合作水平，為中東命運共同體建設提供有力支撐。中方讚賞東方堅持戰略自主，堅守公平正義，堅定支援東國防和軍隊建設發展。我們願同東方一道，密切戰略協同，提升合作質效，推動兩軍關係邁上新臺階。訪問期間，東帝汶總理夏納納為董軍舉行歡迎儀式，並進行正式會談。(新華社)

【進一步完善全國碳排放計量技術體系 三部門聯合印發指導目錄】市場監管總局、國家發展改革委、生態環境部近日聯合印發《碳排放計量能力建設指導目錄（2026版）》。作為2024版目錄的更新版本，2026版目錄進一步健全完善全國碳排放計量技術體系，為我國碳市場的發展提供明確的計量指南。相較於2024版目錄，2026版目錄實現全方位擴容、系統性最佳化，技術覆蓋範圍擴大，標準規範體系完備度大幅提升。其中，關鍵測量引數由39個增至58個，檢測標準方法從82種擴充套件至169種，測量儀器裝置由108種增至229種，國家計量技術規範從85項增至156項，社會公用計量標準從55項擴充套件至115項。（央視新聞）

【2026年個人資訊保護系列專項行動取得階段性成效】2026年個人資訊保護系列專項行動開展以來，中央網信辦、工業和資訊化部、公安部會同相關部門，加強系統謀劃部署，強化協調聯動，持續開展巡查檢測，加強典型問題公開通報和督促整改，各項任務取得階段性成效。一是累計對2萬餘款App、SDK個人資訊收集使用情況開展核查檢測，督促4000餘款完成合規整改，公開通報1100餘款存在違法違規問題的App、SDK，對400餘款採取下架等處置處罰措施。二是針對個人資訊處理規則未明確收集個人資訊用於廣告、使用者畫像，未提供個性化廣告關閉選項等問題，對1000餘家企業和機構的相關產品開展核查檢測並督促整改。三是開展教育、交通、衛生健康、金融等領域個人資訊風險排查，累計摸排9萬餘家企業和機構，發現並督促整改各類隱患問題1.2萬餘個。四是加大個人資訊違法犯罪打擊力度，加強線索監測發現，嚴打涉資訊洩露、資訊倒賣等違法犯罪行為，嚴懲行業“內鬼”。（中國網信網）

【LME copper slides after SHFE close as LME stocks jump】LME copper fell sharply after the Shanghai close on Aug. 19. Early trade hovered around $13,960/t, briefly topping $13,980/t before collapsing below $13,900/t to an intraday low near $13,880/t. LME inventories rose to 235,975 t, up 12,425 t versus the previous session (inflows 17,000 t, outflows 4,575 t). Canceled warrants dropped to 77,225 t, down 18,650 t, lowering the canceled-warrant ratio to 32.73%. The simultaneous rise in LME stocks and decline in canceled warrants implies more exchange-deliverable supply, exerting pressure on high copper prices; market focus remains on inventory flows and high-price positioning.

【基本半導體：與優必選達成戰略合作】基本半導體8月19日在港交所公告，基本半導體已與深圳市優必選科技股份有限公司達成戰略合作。雙方將圍繞碳化矽功率器件在具身智慧人形機器人領域的應用開展深度合作，面向電源管理、運動控制等應用場景，打造高效能、高可靠性的碳化矽功率器件解決方案，提升具身智慧人形機器人能效水平與操作精度，加速碳化矽功率器件在具身智慧領域的規模化應用。此外，雙方將攜手拓展半導體智慧製造應用場景，推動半導體制造與具身智慧的深度融合。

【小馬智行王皓俊：將在歐洲加大投放Robotaxi推行共建模式】小馬智行(02026.HK)CFO王皓俊日前在接受採訪時介紹，小馬智行海外合計部署規劃已經超過4000輛Robotaxi，其中較大的亮點是近期小馬智行和Uber共同宣佈將在歐洲五座重點城市部署超過2000輛的計劃。“歐洲本身是我們認可的一個非常高價值的海外市場，小馬智行和Uber都認為2000輛只是初期的部署規劃。隨著歐洲整體Robotaxi市場的成熟，未來肯定還會有更大量的投放。”從全年來看，王皓俊表示，小馬智行也有信心能夠超額完成2026年的Robotaxi營收目標。同時，小馬智行也在穩步向2026年底將向超過20城投放3500輛Robotaxi的目標推進。“我們對實現這些目標非常有信心。”（上證報）

【Pony.ai CFO says will scale Robotaxi deployment in Europe under co-build model】Pony.ai (02026.HK) CFO Wang Haojun said the company’s overseas deployment plan now exceeds 4,000 Robotaxis. 【Russia to import nearly 270,000 tonnes of refined products from Asia in August — trade sources】Preliminary shipping data and trade sources show Russia will import nearly 270,000 tonnes of refined products from Asia in August via ship-to-ship (STS) transfers to ease fuel shortages after Ukrainian strikes damaged its refineries. About one-third of the volumes reportedly originate in India; the remainder were loaded off Korea and Malaysia. Traders organised STS transfers between tankers, likely to obscure origin and route amid sanctions risk. Vortexa and Kpler data and trade sources show no comparable shipments in July. Two tankers are due to reach Russia’s Far East this week: one loaded at least 40,000 tonnes of jet fuel via STS near the Johor Strait, said to originate in India; another loaded nearly 30,000 tonnes of gasoline via STS near Yeosu, South Korea, in early August.

【Cyprus says it will not be a target of Iranian strikes】On Aug. 19 a Cypriot government official told media Cyprus would not be a target of Iranian strikes and said Nicosia is maintaining communications with Iranian authorities. Iranian internal sources the same day warned that, if the US further escalates the conflict, Iran could strike targets in Europe, naming Bulgaria’s Bezmer airbase, which hosts US tanker aircraft, and the RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus as potential targets.

【李強會見厄瓜多總統諾沃亞】8月19日上午，國務院總理李強在北京人民大會堂會見來華進行國事訪問的厄瓜多總統諾沃亞。 李強表示，今年適逢中厄建立全面戰略伙伴關係10週年。這些年，在雙方共同努力下，兩國各領域合作穩步推進，取得不少新成果。昨天，習近平主席同總統先生舉行會晤，就深化中厄關係作出進一步規劃。面對世界百年變局加速演進，中方願同厄方一道遵循兩國元首戰略引領，加強溝通協調，築牢政治互信，拓展全方位互利合作，更好服務兩國現代化建設。 李強指出，中方願同厄方推進高質量共建“一帶一路”，繼續實施好中厄自貿協定，發揮經濟互補優勢，擴大雙邊貿易規模，鞏固拓展能源、礦產、基礎設施建設等傳統領域合作，深化5G、人工智慧等新興領域合作，取得更多務實成果。中方願進口厄方更多優質農食產品，鼓勵有實力的中國企業赴厄投資，希望厄方保護好企業合法權益。雙方要加強防災、教育、醫療、人文等交流合作，增進兩國民生福祉。當前拉美和加勒比局勢複雜多變，中國願始終做地區國家可信賴的合作伙伴，同厄瓜多等各方一道拓展中拉合作的廣度深度，推動中拉命運共同體建設不斷走深走實。 諾沃亞表示，中國是厄瓜多的重要合作伙伴和好朋友，兩國關係始終保持良好發展。(新華社)

【Wuhan pilots housing provident fund deposit-free and direct rent-payment service】On the 18th, the Wuhan Housing Provident Fund Management Center and partner departments launched a pilot allowing eligible tenants to freeze an equivalent balance in their housing provident fund account in lieu of a cash security deposit and to authorize direct rent payment from the account. On move-out, outstanding charges are deducted and the remaining frozen balance is automatically released. The pilot covers about 15,000 units across 11 rental outlets; Wuhan housing provident fund account holders who meet the requirements can apply.

【免押+租金直付 武漢落地公積金租房新服務】近日（18日），由武漢住房公積金管理中心等部門合作的公積金免押與租金直付服務正式落地湖北武漢。透過公積金免押服務，符合條件的租客，只需要授權凍結公積金賬戶和押金等額的餘額，就能替代現金押金，退租時，扣除應付費用後，剩餘押金自動解凍。據瞭解，此次推出的公積金免押與租金直付服務，將以武漢市11個聯投新青年門店為核心試點，覆蓋約1.5萬間房源，有武漢市公積金賬戶並符合相關要求的租客群體均可申請。（央視新聞）

【直擊WRC丨對話小米機器人總經理向迪昀：兩年前“鐵大”時速已超12km，但我們選了另一條路】2026世界機器人大會（WRC 2026）上，小米新一代人形機器人“鐵大”首次亮相展會。該款機器人身高約1.70米，體重66公斤，全身擁有66個自由度，其中一半集中在手部。 在與新浪科技等媒體溝通中，小米機器人事業部總經理向迪昀坦言，早在2024年，小米就已完成了運動控制的基礎工程化突破，“我們一個50公斤的機器人奔跑速度大概是12到13公里每小時。”向迪昀坦言。運動效能達到行業領先水平為什麼還選擇轉身另一個方向？向迪昀坦言，這背後是雷軍自2021年立項以來始終堅持的一個追問——“這個東西到底有什麼用？”正是在這個追問下，小米在2023年之後暫停了所有技術釋出和對外宣發，但研發投入從未削減，反而逐年追加。在他看來，大廠真正的優勢在於工程轉化能力——“當看到這個技術工程正規化之後，想把它轉化成成熟穩定的工程產品時，對整個產業工程體系的投入會有更多和更好的方式。” 而這，正是小米機器人的戰略邏輯。向迪昀坦言，小米的願景是“讓每一個人享受科技帶來的美好生活”——而這份美好，必須落腳在真實的生產線上。（新浪科技）

【Samsung: advanced nodes to drive over half of foundry revenue this year; AI/HPC >30%】Samsung expects advanced-process manufacturing to contribute more than half of wafer foundry revenue this year, with AI and high-performance computing workloads accounting for over 30%, higher than the 15–20% at end-2025. Eurozone Current Account Surplus Widens in June — The Euro Area's current account surplus widened to €46.9 billion in June 2026 from €37.6 billion a year earlier. The primary income surplus, which includes flows such as dividends, wages and direct investment, rose to €15.3 billion from €5 billion. Also, the services surplus rose to €24.1 billion from 22.6 billion. On the other hand, the goods surplus narrowed to €21.5 billion from €23.6 billion and the secondary income deficit increased to €14.1 billion from €13.7 billion. The seasonally adjusted current account surplus increased to €35.1 billion in June from €25.8 billion a month earlier, above market expectations of €22.1 billion.

【面向2.5D/3D先進封裝 長電科技高深寬比TSV研發取得突破】8月19日，長電科技宣佈，公司在高深寬比先進TSV（Through-Silicon Via，矽通孔）技術研發方面取得重要進展，並與合作伙伴共同完成樣品試製。長電科技的TSV製備方案面向2.5D/3D先進封裝、矽基互連和多維異質異構整合等高階先進封裝應用，旨在進一步增強公司在微系統整合平臺中的關鍵底層工藝能力，為高算力、高存力晶片的系統級整合提供更加完整、靈活的一站式製造支撐。
【三星：今年先進製程將貢獻晶圓代工業務超過一半的收入 SF4生產線一直滿負荷執行】三星預計，今年先進製程將貢獻晶圓代工業務超過一半的收入，而AI和高效能運算（HPC）應用佔比將超過30%，高於2025年末的15%至20%。由於臺積電產能趨緊，三星獲得了更強的價格談判能力。一名熟悉三星運營情況的人士表示，三星位於韓國平澤工廠的SF4生產線自去年年底以來一直滿負荷執行。

【羅馬尼亞：多瑙河入境流量創新低】據羅馬尼亞國家水文與水資源管理研究所當地時間8月19日釋出的最新預報，未來三天，多瑙河在羅馬尼亞入境河段的流量將維持在1300立方米每秒，預計到8月25日升至1350立方米每秒左右，但仍低於1985年創下的此前歷史最低水平1400立方米每秒，遠低於8月平均流量3900立方米每秒。近日，由於多瑙河水位連達歷史新低，該國唯一核電站切爾納沃德核電站冷卻水供應不足，已經全面停運。切爾納沃德核電站的兩座核反應堆原本供應該國大約20%的電力。（央視新聞）

【因需求激增 據悉三星晶片代工價格最高上漲15%】兩名知情人士表示，三星電子已將部分先進晶片代工服務的新訂單價格上調至高15%，因人工智慧晶片需求激增，導致代工業務產能趨緊。此次漲價標誌著三星代工業務的轉機。根據行業估算，該業務自2022年以來一直處於虧損狀態。儘管三星在儲存晶片價格飆升的推動下實現創紀錄利潤，但其代工部門一直難以縮小與臺積電的差距。知情人士表示，三星7月上調了採用其4奈米工藝（SF4）製造晶片的價格。其5奈米制程（SF5）生產的晶圓價格上漲10%至15%，而採用較老的8奈米工藝生產的晶圓價格上漲近10%。三星方面拒絕置評，稱公司不會透露有關運營事項的具體細節。

【Sources: Samsung raises foundry prices up to 15% as AI demand tightens capacity】Two people familiar with the matter said Samsung Electronics has raised prices on some advanced foundry wafer orders by as much as 15% as AI-chip demand surges and capacity tightens. The company increased July pricing for chips made on its 4nm (SF4) process; wafer prices for the 5nm (SF5) node rose 10–15% and 8nm wafers climbed roughly 10%. Industry estimates show Samsung's foundry unit has been loss-making since 2022; the price hikes mark a turnaround for the business. Samsung declined to comment, saying it does not disclose operational details.

【International Criminal Court strongly opposes U.S. sanctions list】The International Criminal Court said on the 19th that U.S. sanctions on the court president, Japanese judge Tomoko Akane, and senior trial lawyer Abdoulaye Seye of the Office of the Prosecutor are a “blatant attack” on the court’s independence. The ICC said it is independently exercising judicial functions under the Rome Statute; to date nine of the court’s 18 judges, two deputy prosecutors, a former prosecutor and one staff member have been sanctioned by the U.S.

【國際刑事法院強烈反對美國新的制裁名單】國際刑事法院19日發表宣告，對美國政府宣佈制裁國際刑事法院院長、日本法官赤根智子和檢察官辦公室高階審判律師、塞內加爾人阿卜杜拉耶·塞耶表示遺憾。宣告說，這些制裁是對國際刑事法院獨立性的“公然攻擊”。國際刑事法院依據《羅馬規約》賦予的職責獨立履行司法職能。目前，該法院18名法官中已有9人、兩名副檢察官、一名前檢察官和一名工作人員受到美國製裁。宣告說，針對法官、檢察官和工作人員的此類措施破壞法治。當司法人員因依法履行職責而受到威脅時，國際法律秩序將受到損害。相關威脅和脅迫措施還可能影響國際犯罪受害者尋求司法救濟的能力。國際刑事法院表示，法院將繼續堅持獨立、公正原則，按照《羅馬規約》履行職責，為國際犯罪受害者伸張正義。（央視新聞）

Central Bank of Iceland Raises Key Rate to 8% — The Central Bank of Iceland raised its key policy rate by 25bps to 8% in August 2026, marking the third consecutive meeting with a 25bp increase. The decision reflected continued uncertainty surrounding global developments and the domestic labour market. Headline inflation rose above 5% in 2026, reaching 5.3% in July, driven by higher public levies and price increases related to the war in the Middle East. Underlying inflation, however, has remained relatively stable and has started to ease, in line with growing slack in the economy. While inflation is expected to rise further in the coming months, the Central Bank anticipates a relatively rapid moderation in 2027. Policymakers judged the latest hike appropriate to ensure that monetary policy remains sufficiently restrictive, while signalling that future decisions will depend on developments in economic activity, inflation, and inflation expectations, which remain elevated.

【App崩潰風波後，奕境汽車又被曝給車主發假冒labubu，客服回應】近日有車主反映稱，參加南昌當地奕境X9預售釋出會，簽到禮品可以選擇領取labubu盲盒一個，拆開後卻發現是假labubu。根據網路上流傳的圖片顯示，車主輸入領取的labubu盲盒防偽碼，在泡泡瑪特官網查詢時顯示防偽碼錯誤，盲盒背面也將“搪膠”錯寫成了“塘膠”。針對此事，奕境汽車客服向新浪科技表示，問題已經瞭解，將核實情況後回電。新浪科技致電南昌奕境汽車使用者中心，一位工作人員表示，自己只負責銷售板塊，對具體情況不太瞭解。此事已經上報廠家，廠家在負責處理相關事宜。（新浪科技）

Hong Kong Stocks Recover From Early Losses — The Hang Seng Index was little changed around 25,468 on Wednesday, recovering from an earlier decline as HKEX shares gained 1.6% to HK$411.40 following the exchange operator’s strong first-half results. Revenue rose 19% year-on-year, attributable profit increased 24%, and the interim dividend was lifted 24%, providing support to market sentiment. At the same time, Hong Kong and China Gas climbed after posting a 23% increase in first-half profit, helping support the broader market. Still, gains were capped by a cautious global backdrop, with investors digesting a selloff in technology shares, elevated US Treasury yields, higher oil prices, and renewed Middle East tensions that weighed on risk appetite across Asian markets. Notable movers included Xiaomi (5.1%), Tencent (0.9%), and Meituan (1.9%). In contrast, SMIC and China Unicom declined 4.6% and 12.8% respectively.

【加拿大政府說本國野火風險仍將處於較高水平】加拿大聯邦政府18日通報說，目前全國共有582起活躍野火，其中31起處於失控狀態。受高溫和乾旱影響，未來數週，該國野火風險仍將處於較高水平。根據加拿大聯邦政府釋出的野火形勢通報，今年以來，加拿大累計發生野火4793起，過火面積達410萬公頃。野火數量與去年同期相比多出200多起，但過火面積低於去年同期。預測顯示，8月至9月，加拿大大部分地區氣溫將高於常年平均水平，加上部分地區持續的乾旱和乾燥，意味著未來數週野火風險仍將處於較高水平。（新華社）

【國聯基金權益投資部總經理甘傳琦離任】國聯基金8月19日公告稱，甘傳琦因個人原因卸任國聯新經濟混合、國聯成長先鋒、國聯高質量成長等產品的基金經理。截至目前，甘傳琦名下已無在管基金。公告顯示，甘傳琦卸任基金產品後並沒有轉任其他崗位，已按規定在基金業協會辦理登出手續。公開資訊顯示，甘傳琦具有15年證券從業經驗，2010年7月至2017年3月曆任博時基金研究員、高階研究員、基金經理助理，2017年4月加入國聯基金，本次離任前為國聯基金權益投資部總經理。

【水利部：太湖流域防汛形勢依然嚴峻複雜】8月19日上午，國家防總副總指揮、水利部部長李國英主持召開專題會商，影片連線水利部太湖流域管理局，分析研判太湖流域汛情發展態勢，進一步安排部署太湖流域洪水防禦工作。李國英指出，受今年第13號颱風“白海豚”及其殘餘環流帶來的強降雨影響，11日太湖發生2026年第1號洪水；14日水位漲至4.20米，太湖發生流域性較大洪水；經過科學精細排程，17日19時40分太湖出現本輪洪水最高水位4.49米（洪峰水位到4.50米時，太湖即發生流域性大洪水），成功避免發生流域性大洪水。當前，太湖水位總體呈波動緩退態勢，預報將於8月底降至4.20米左右，9月上旬末退至警戒水位以下。太湖及周邊河網長時間高水位執行，疊加風浪影響，堤防出險風險增加，加之後期可能有颱風登陸影響，太湖流域防汛形勢依然嚴峻複雜。

Sterling Firms at 3-Month High — The British pound strengthened to around $1.356, remaining close to a three-month high as investors assessed the latest UK inflation and labour-market data. Consumer inflation accelerated to 2.9% in July from 2.6% in June, matching expectations, while core inflation remained unchanged at 2.6%. The figures prompted traders to modestly reduce expectations for a Bank of England rate hike later this year. Earlier labour-market data showed unemployment holding at 4.9%, above forecasts, while payroll employment declined by 86,000 year-on-year. Regular earnings growth remained relatively firm at 3.5%. Despite signs of resilience in the UK economy, elevated oil prices and uncertainty surrounding the US-Iran conflict continue to pose risks to the inflation outlook. Meanwhile, the dollar index remained near multi-month lows, providing additional support to sterling. Softer US economic data led investors to scale back expectations for further Federal Reserve tightening, weighing on the dollar.

【鎮海股份：控股股東舜通集團擬協議轉讓15%股份，控制權將變更】鎮海股份公告，控股股東寧波舜通集團有限公司與上海樸未來泉企業管理諮詢合夥企業（有限合夥）簽署《股份轉讓協議》，擬以15.51元/股的價格轉讓其持有的公司3580.29萬股股份（佔公司總股本的15%），轉讓總對價為人民幣5.55億元。本次權益變動前，舜通集團及一致行動人舜建集團合計持有公司5063.98萬股，佔總股本21.22%；變動後合計持有1483.7萬股，佔總股本6.22%。本次交易完成後，樸未來泉將成為公司控股股東，實際控制人變更為張文龍先生。本次交易尚需取得國有資產監督管理部門批准、上交所合規性確認等程式。

【2026年上半年京津冀經濟總量同比增長5.1%】記者19日從京津冀協同發展統計監測辦公室瞭解到，2026年上半年，京津冀實現地區生產總值6.0萬億元，按不變價格計算，同比增長5.1%。 京津冀全域面積21.6萬平方公里，常住人口超1億。地域毗鄰、人文相親的區位稟賦，為三地深度融合、協同共進築牢根基。 資料顯示，今年上半年，京津冀區域實現服務業增加值4.3萬億元，同比增長5.8%，三地分別增長6.1%、5.5%和5.5%。高階製造表現活躍，京津規模以上高技術製造業分別增長15.7%和8.7%，京冀規模以上工業戰略性新興產業分別增長12.8%和10.9%。（新華社）

【立昂微：12英寸矽片出貨量大幅增長 矽片已進入漲價週期】立昂微(605358.SH)釋出投資者關係活動記錄表公告，公司2021年定增對應的募集資金投資專案均已如期投產。隨著半導體行業景氣度復甦，半導體矽片市場需求旺盛，目前已進入漲價週期。公司2026年上半年扭虧為盈，核心驅動因素為半導體矽片板塊盈利水平大幅改善。受AI算力產業帶動，市場重摻矽片需求快速釋放，疊加公司12英寸矽片產能持續爬坡、產品結構向高階化持續升級，整體產銷規模穩步擴張，12英寸矽片出貨量實現大幅增長，有效攤薄單位生產成本，矽片業務綜合毛利率同比提升明顯。公司目前正在進行12英寸矽片的擴產，同時基於衢州基地、杭州東芯2016-2017年左右開始購買的固定資產折舊逐步計提完畢，預計未來固定資產折舊金額的增速將逐步放緩。公司暫無SOI矽片相關佈局規劃。

【提醒中國公民謹慎赴帛琉旅遊】近年，帛琉發生多起針對遊客盜搶案件，當事人損失嚴重。當地涉水環境複雜，搜救力量、醫療條件有限，涉中國遊客意外事故頻發。外交部和中國駐密克羅尼西亞聯邦使館提醒中國公民注意帛琉安全風險，謹慎赴帛琉旅遊，已在當地人員務必提高警惕，增強風險防範意識。

【韓國家庭信貸邁入2000萬億韓元時代】受住房相關貸款及用於槓桿炒股的信用貸款大幅增加推動，韓國家庭信貸規模首次突破2000萬億韓元。韓國的家庭信貸主要由金融機構發放貸款與信用卡賒購兩部分共同組成。韓國央行於當地時間19日釋出的第二季度家庭信貸資料顯示，當季家庭信貸為2019.8萬億韓元（約1.48萬億美元），較上一季度增加25.9萬億韓元。這是該資料有史以來首次突破2000萬億韓元大關，且第二季度增幅為2021年第三季度以來的最大單季增幅。

【大摩警告記憶體漲價情況仍然激進 Q3成熟製程DRAM可能漲價50%】第三季度的全球記憶體漲價情況仍然嚴重。根據摩根士丹利的最新預測，2026年第三季度，DDR4等成熟DRAM的價格將上漲50%，第四季度將再漲10%。摩根士丹利表示，成熟的DRAM和NAND晶片的供應緊張局面，即將進一步惡化。而造成這一局面的主要原因在於供應端的產能轉移，儲存器製造商正持續將產能轉向HBM、DDR5和更高層數的NAND快閃記憶體。而新型DDR5晶片的零售價格也絲毫沒有降溫的跡象，據美國銀行的資料，8月，DDR5-5600/6400 24GB的現貨價格環比上漲了8%，同比漲幅高達483%。大摩還強調，SLC NAND快閃記憶體的價格漲幅可能將更加激進，該機構預計該品類在今年剩餘的兩個季度中每個季度都將上漲50%。
【華陽集團：控股股東籌劃控制權變更事項 股票繼續停牌】華陽集團(002906)8月19日公告，因控股股東籌劃公司控制權變更事項，公司股票自8月18日開市起停牌。目前各方正在積極推進上述工作，公司預計無法在8月20日開市起復牌。公司股票自8月20日開市起繼續停牌，預計停牌時間不超過3個交易日。

【時代電氣：2026年上半年營收130.71億元 同比增7.01%】時代電氣公告稱，2026年上半年實現營業收入130.71億元，同比增長7.01%；歸母淨利潤17.12億元，同比增長2.44%；基本每股收益1.25元/股，同比增長3.31%。研發投入13.79億元，同比增長8.53%。2026年半年度擬每10股派發現金股利4.6元（含稅），合計派發現金紅利約6.12億元，佔當期歸母淨利潤的35.75%。2026年2月10日至6月25日，公司累計回購H股2724.50萬股，使用資金約10.26億港元，所回購股份已全部登出。

【華魯恆升：2026年上半年營收171.62億元 淨利同比增49.98%】華魯恆升公告稱，2026年上半年實現營業收入171.62億元，同比增長8.87%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤23.53億元，同比增長49.98%；扣非淨利潤23.46億元，同比增長50.49%。公司擬以實施權益分派股權登記日登記的總股本為基數，向全體股東每10股派發現金紅利2.60元（含稅），不送紅股，不進行公積金轉增股本。

Italy Current Account Surplus Narrows in June — Italy’s current account surplus amounted to EUR 5,838.8 million in June 2026, narrowing from EUR 6,639.4 million in the same month a year earlier, as surpluses in goods, services and primary income declined. The goods surplus fell to EUR 4,852.4 million from EUR 5,625.6 million, while the services surplus edged down to EUR 1,539.4 million from EUR 1,558.0 million. The primary income surplus also decreased to EUR 735.6 million from EUR 761.1 million. Meanwhile, the secondary income deficit narrowed slightly to EUR 1,288.7 million from EUR 1,305.2 million last year.
【天璣資料與海光資訊簽署戰略合作協議】8月18日，上海天璣資料技術有限公司與海光資訊簽署戰略合作協議。據悉，雙方將圍繞國產晶片與資料庫的軟硬協同與深度融合展開全面合作。

【華盛鋰電：終止年處理14.4萬噸危廢處置投資專案】華盛鋰電公告稱，公司董事會審議透過議案，終止投資年處理144,000噸固液氣綜合危廢焚燒處置&資源化迴圈利用中心專案，該專案總投資約3.60億元，原計劃由公司與宜興福鼎、夢澤國投共同出資設立華烽綠能實施，公司持股70%。截至目前該專案僅開展部分前期籌備工作，尚未實際實施建設，前期投入資金規模較小，終止該專案不會對公司生產經營及財務狀況產生重大影響。
【華盛鋰電：2026年上半年實現扭虧為盈，淨利潤為2.23億元】華盛鋰電公告，2026年上半年營業收入7.92億元，同比增長126.51%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤為2.23億元，上年同期淨利潤為-6340.65萬元，實現扭虧為盈。公司擬向全體股東每10股派發現金紅利3元（含稅）。

【US yield surge knocks KOSPI 5.8%; foreigners, institutions sell KRW4.8tln, retail buys】US Treasury yields jumped, knocking risk appetite and prompting foreign and institutional investors to sell a combined KRW4.8 tln (~$3.5bn) of Korean equities. KOSPI closed at 6,471.17, down 5.80% after an intraday low of 6,400.81; retail investors were net buyers of KRW4.6367 tln. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell more than 7% and 9%, respectively. Foreigners were net sellers of KRW3.5036 tln, the largest net outflow this month and the biggest single-day net sale since the 28th of last month (KRW4.5261 tln); institutions net sold KRW1.3244 tln. Analysts cited Middle East tensions and the US yield spike — including a rise in the 30-year Treasury yield to 5.33%, its highest since 2007 — and said failure to extend a US-Iran ceasefire lifted oil and inflation concerns. Higher rates are increasing AI-sector capex pressure and, together with worries over slow profit improvement at OpenAI and cooling storage-chip demand, have intensified profit-taking in previously strong chip names, Daishin Securities said.
【澳大利亞對進口自中國的輕型鋼螺柱和軌道作出反補貼部分終裁】8月17日，澳大利亞反傾銷委員會發布第2026/108號公告，對進口自中國的輕型鋼螺柱和軌道作出反補貼部分終裁，裁定出口商文安縣凱澤建材有限公司‌在調查期間補貼微量，因此終止對其反補貼調查。同時，委員會將繼續進行對中國所有出口商的反傾銷調查以及對不合作出口商和其他出口商反補貼調查。

Stocks in Malta Hit 25-month High — MSE increased to 4220.00 Index Points, the highest since July 2024. Over the past 4 weeks, Malta Stock Exchange gained 1.94%, and in the last 12 months, it increased 9.19%.

UK 10-Year Gilt Yield Edges Down After Inflation Data — The UK 10-year gilt yield eased to around 5.05% as investors assessed the latest inflation and labour-market data for clues on the Bank of England’s policy outlook. Headline CPI rose to 2.9% year-on-year in July from 2.6% in June, matching market expectations, while core inflation remained unchanged at 2.6%. The figures were broadly in line with forecasts and prompted traders to modestly reduce bets on a rate increase before year-end. Recent labour data also pointed to a cooling jobs market, with unemployment unexpectedly holding at 4.9% and payroll employment declining by 86,000 year-on-year. Regular earnings growth was slightly stronger than anticipated at 3.5%. While the UK economy has shown some resilience, elevated oil prices and fading hopes of a US-Iran agreement continue to pose inflation risks. Markets still price at least one BoE hike this year, although most economists expect rates to remain unchanged.

【正泰電器：2026年上半年光伏電站電費收入47.92億元】正泰電器公告稱，截至2026年6月30日，公司持有光伏電站裝機容量28949.95兆瓦，其中戶用光伏電站裝機容量26021.94兆瓦。2026年半年度公司光伏電站總發電量165.17億千瓦時，總上網電量165.11億千瓦時，平均上網電價0.33元/千瓦時，實現電費收入47.92億元。其中集中式光伏電站電費收入3.78億元，小型工商業光伏電站電費收入1.50億元，戶用光伏電站電費收入42.65億元。上述經營資料未經審計。

【Iran: no direct talks with US】On the 19th a news agency, citing sources, reported Iran has held no direct talks with the US after Washington violated a US-Iran memorandum of understanding. A source close to the negotiating team said talks with the US were suspended after that breach. Iran's talks with Oman on the Strait of Hormuz were unrelated to the US. CNN reported on the 18th that President Trump instructed his negotiating team to cease contact with Iran; US officials told CNN Trump is dissatisfied Iran has not met his demands and wants to resume contact only if Iranian leaders demonstrate willingness to reach the agreement he seeks.

【伊朗稱未與美國進行任何直接對話】伊朗法爾斯通訊社19日援引訊息人士的話報道說，在美國違反伊美諒解備忘錄後，伊朗未與美國進行任何直接對話。據報道，一名接近談判團隊的訊息人士說，在美國違反諒解備忘錄後，伊朗與美方的會談已暫停。伊朗與阿曼就霍爾木茲海峽問題舉行的會談與美國無關。據美國有線電視新聞網18日報道，美國總統特朗普已指示其談判團隊停止與伊朗方面接觸。報道援引美國官員的話說，特朗普對伊朗不願滿足其要求感到不滿，希望在伊朗領導人釋放新的意願、表明願達成他所尋求的協議後，再重新展開接觸。（新華社）

South Africa Inflation Rate Cools More than Anticipated — South Africa's annual inflation rate eased to 4.3% in July 2026 from a two-year high of 5% in the prior month and below analysts' estimates of 4.5%. This marked the first slowdown in five months, driven mainly by softer prices for food and non-alcoholic beverages (0.9% vs 1.6% in June), housing & utilities (5.2% vs 5.5%), and transportation (8.9% vs 12.7%). On a monthly basis, the CPI rose by 0.2% in July, down from a 0.7% increase in the month before.
【廈鎢新能：2026年上半年淨利潤4.91億元，同比增46.62%】廈鎢新能公告，2026年上半年營業收入144.88億元，同比增長91.09%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤4.91億元，同比增長46.62%；扣非淨利潤4.88億元，同比增長67.90%。公司擬每10股派發現金紅利3元（含稅）。
【美國對進口自中國的L-賴氨酸作出雙反產業損害終裁】8月18日，美國國際貿易委員會（ITC）投票對進口自中國的L-賴氨酸作出反傾銷和反補貼產業損害肯定性終裁，認定被主張存在傾銷和補貼行為的涉案產品對美國相關產業造成了實質性損害。基於美國國際貿易委員會的肯定性終裁，美國商務部將對上述涉案產品頒佈反傾銷和反補貼徵稅令。本案主要涉及美國海關編碼2922.41.0090項下產品。

【士蘭微獲得德國萊茵TÜV頒發的ISO 26262 ASIL D等多項認證】據士蘭微訊息，近日，德國萊茵TÜV集團（簡稱“TÜV萊茵”）正式向士蘭微頒發三項重要認證：ISO 26262功能安全管理體系ASIL D實踐級（ML 3）認證證書、功能安全產品ASIL D認證證書、ISO/IEC 17025：2017目擊檢測實驗室資質認證證書。此次認證標誌著士蘭微已具備符合ISO26262最高等級ASIL D要求的車規產品開發流程和產品實踐能力，公司的可靠性試驗檢驗中心也同步透過萊茵目擊實驗室認證資質，為全品類車規級產品的開發奠定了堅實基礎。

【Euro area current-account surplus widens in June】ECB data on Wednesday showed the euro area current-account surplus widened in June, led by higher primary income including dividends, wages and direct investment. Seasonally adjusted surplus rose to €35.1bn in June from €25.8bn in May (€40.7bn). Unadjusted figures show a €46.9bn surplus and a €6.1bn deficit. Over the 12 months to June, the euro area’s current-account surplus as a share of GDP narrowed to 1.7% from 2.0% in the prior 12 months.
【海陸重工：2026年上半年淨利潤1.61億元，同比下降15.87%】海陸重工公告，2026年上半年營業收入10.51億元，同比增長1.85%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤1.61億元，同比下降15.87%。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤1.39億元，同比下降24.42%。公司利潤分配預案為：以總股本7.33億股為基數，向全體股東每10股派發現金紅利0.6元（含稅）。

【巴西對涉華玻璃纖維作出反傾銷初裁：建議徵收不超6個月的臨時反傾銷稅】8月18日，巴西發展、工業、貿易和服務部外貿秘書處釋出2026年第75號公告，對原產於中國和埃及的玻璃纖維作出反傾銷肯定性初裁，建議徵收不超過 6個月的臨時反傾銷稅，中國為211.78－456.44美元/噸，埃及為243.42美元/噸。
【菲達環保：2026年上半年新增訂單24.24億元】菲達環保公告，公司2026年1-6月新增環保裝置類訂單金額為24.24億元，其中環保裝置類22.14億元，其他2.09億元。截至報告期末，公司在手環保裝置類訂單金額80.18億元，其中已履行金額13.89億元、待履行金額66.29億元。

【棕櫚油價格升至八個月高位 因厄爾尼諾加劇東南亞乾旱】棕櫚油價格週二收於2024年12月以來最高水平後延續漲勢。主要產區持續乾旱引發市場對供應前景的擔憂，支撐油價上行。週三，吉隆坡棕櫚油期貨一度上漲0.9%，至每噸4,905林吉特，連續第三個交易日走高。IcebergX Sdn.高階交易員David Ng表示，市場預期惡劣天氣將抑制全球兩大棕櫚油生產國印尼和馬來西亞的產量，這正推動價格上漲。根據美國農業部8月18日釋出的週報，正在形成的厄爾尼諾現象導致馬來西亞和印尼天氣明顯偏幹，許多地區降雨稀少甚至完全無雨。報告稱，這種情況可能開始對油棕樹以及水稻、玉米和大豆等作物造成壓力。
【伊朗議員：即將與阿曼釋出聯合宣告 宣佈一條海峽新通道】據伊朗媒體報道，伊朗議員Abbas Moghtadaei表示：“伊朗和阿曼即將釋出一份聯合宣告，宣佈一條獨立於南部航線的新霍爾木茲海峽通道。”Moghtadaei是伊朗議會國家安全與外交政策委員會副主席，他沒有提供有關該提案的更多細節。

【Iran lawmaker says joint statement with Oman imminent to announce new Strait of Hormuz corridor】Iranian state TV reported MP Abbas Moghtadaei said Iran and Oman are set to issue a joint statement announcing a new Strait of Hormuz corridor independent of the southern route. Moghtadaei, deputy chair of parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, provided no further details.

【全球首款實體瘤CAR-T賣99萬元，科濟藥業稱銷售額在下半年確認】今年6月22日，科濟藥業（02171.HK）的愷力美作為全球首款治療實體瘤的CAR-T細胞產品獲批國內上市，用於晚期胃癌治療，但售價高達99萬元，究竟會有多少患者願意買單？隨著公司半年報披露，該問題受到投資者關注。8月19日上午，科濟藥業在業績會上表示，愷力美已在北京高博醫院開出全國首張臨床處方，復旦大學附屬中山醫院已完成全球首例患者的細胞採集，嘉會國際腫瘤中心已完成首例外籍患者的T細胞採集。這款藥將於下半年開始確認收入。科濟藥業方面預計愷力美在中國內地銷售峰值可達到20億元以上，預計2026年可接受200單治療。

【澳大利亞對進口自中國的可互換夾緊螺栓夾頭作出反傾銷行政複審終裁】8月17日，澳大利亞反傾銷稅委員會發布第2026/057號公告，澳大利亞工業與科技部長接受了澳大利亞反傾銷複審組對進口自中國的可互換夾緊螺栓夾頭作出的反傾銷行政複審終裁建議，確定寧波鋒暉金屬製品有限公司的修訂後正常價值以及將該企業的反傾銷幅度和反傾銷稅由原22.2%調整為21.9%，其他出口商的反傾銷幅度和反傾銷稅維持26.3%不變。本案涉及澳大利亞海關編碼7326.90.90.60項下的產品。

【South Korea equities: investor deposits jump 4.0447 tln won in one day; retail sentiment may be recovering】Korea Financial Investment Association said on the 19th that as of the 18th investor deposits at domestic securities firms stood at 104.755 tln won, up 4.0447 tln won from the previous trading day (14th) and above the 100 tln won threshold. Absent new IPO subscription demand, a single-day rise of about 4 tln won is unusually large. Margin loan (credit financing) balances rose 237 bln won to 31.1045 tln won, the highest this month. Receivables from ultra-short-term financing increased to 920.2 bln won from 867.0 bln won, while forced liquidations tied to unpaid receivables amounted to 6.4 bln won, or 0.7% of receivables. Market participants link the flows to recent KOSPI gains and say rising deposits and leverage suggest retail investor sentiment may be gradually recovering.

【Eurozone bond yields edge lower, stabilizing after Tuesday sell-off】Eurozone government bond yields edged lower, tracking US Treasuries as global markets stabilized after Tuesday’s sell-off. Final July inflation data remain pending, limiting near-term data-driven moves. RBC Capital Markets said detail on July inflation drivers should prove relatively muted and expects preliminary readings to be confirmed. Germany will auction €6bn of 2036 bunds in August; Finland plans a new seven-year issue as scheduled. The 10-year German bund yield was down 0.2bp intraday at 3.253%, after hitting 3.272% on Tuesday.

Brent Rises for 4th Session — Brent crude climbed toward $92 per barrel on Wednesday, extending gains for a fourth consecutive session as the US and Iran showed little indication of reaching an agreement to end the conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, keeping supply concerns elevated. President Donald Trump said there were no ongoing negotiations with Tehran while confirming that the US naval blockade remains in effect. Shipping risks in Hormuz also remain despite Trump’s claim that the waterway is open and mines have been cleared, with limited traffic still passing through the strategic route. Iranian forces have intensified hostilities over the past week, while eight attacks on vessels transiting Hormuz, including ships linked to the UAE and Saudi Arabia, have been reported so far this month. In the US, industry data showed crude inventories fell by 328,000 barrels last week, following a 9.07 million-barrel increase in the previous week.

【跨境人口販賣17人被提起公訴】近日，上海市人民檢察院第二分院經依法審查，對盤踞緬甸妙瓦底地區，以出賣人口為目的，以出國務工為誘餌，誘騙中國境內公民王某等被害人至境外，依託武裝人員強行押送至緬甸妙瓦底地區，並對眾多被害人實施搶劫、毆打、非法拘禁，對其中部分女性被害人實施姦淫和強迫賣淫，並轉賣至緬甸電詐園區從事電詐活動的跨境人口販賣集團成員王某軍、張某飛、毋某龍等17人，根據《中華人民共和國刑法》《中華人民共和國刑事訴訟法》等相關規定，以涉嫌拐賣婦女罪、非法拘禁罪、搶劫罪、綁架罪等向上海市第二中級人民法院提起公訴。

【Shanghai to deepen infrastructure, expand computing capacity】The Shanghai municipal government office issued the Digital Shanghai "15th Five" plan, directing deeper infrastructure build-out and expansion of computing capacity. Rupiah Steady as Bank Indonesia Holds Rates — The Indonesian rupiah was largely unchanged on Wednesday afternoon, hovering just below IDR 17,850 per U.S. dollar after Bank Indonesia kept its key rate unchanged at 5.75% for a second straight month, in line with expectations. It was the first policy decision under acting Governor Destry Damayanti, who assumed the role following Perry Warjiyo’s abrupt departure last month. So far this year, BI has lifted rates by a cumulative 100bps to bolster the currency and investor confidence. Destry emphasized that the pause reflects efforts to balance currency stability, inflation control, and growth. She also noted that forex reserves remain more than enough to safeguard the rupiah. In the near term, the central bank is expected to lean more on its broader toolkit, forex intervention and high-yielding central bank securities, rather than rate moves alone. Globally, the U.S. dollar index eased after, with investors awaiting the Fed's July meeting minutes for clues on the policy outlook.

Indonesia Loan Growth Highest Since 2014 — Indonesia's loan growth increased by 13.58% year-on-year in July 2026, accelerating from a 12.67% rise in the previous month and marking the strongest pace since August 2014. The acceleration was supported by accommodative macroprudential policies, continuously pursued through the optimization of the Macroprudential Liquidity Incentive (KLM) policy to encourage increased bank lending and financing to priority sectors. As of the first week of August 2026, KLM incentives obtained by banks totaled IDR 446.5 trillion. The growth was also supported by the banking sector's high Capital Adequacy Ratio, which stood at 23.70% in June 2026.

【日本東證指數創3月以來最大跌幅 債券收益率飆升衝擊AI板塊】日本股市週三重挫，東證指數錄得3月以來最大跌幅。隨著債券收益率攀升至數十年來高位，市場對融資成本上升和日本央行加息的擔憂加劇，AI相關股票首當其衝遭到拋售。受電子和銀行板塊拖累，東證指數下跌3.1%。科技股權重較高的日經225指數也下跌3.2%，其中儲存晶片製造商鎧俠控股和光纖電纜製造商古河電氣跌幅居前。日本10年期國債收益率週三雖小幅回落，但仍接近數十年來高位。此前該收益率週二上行至1996年以來未見水平。對通脹的擔憂以及市場對日本央行可能於下月加息的猜測，一直在打壓債券價格。Iwai Cosmo Securities高階分析師Shoichi Arisawa表示，對借貸成本上升的擔憂正促使投資者拋售科技股，而其中許多個股的估值本已偏高。“市場對債券收益率的整體焦慮正在壓制AI和晶片相關股票，”他說，並補充稱，日本央行短期內可能加息所帶來的不確定性進一步加劇了市場的避險情緒。

【朗迪集團：擬授權管理層使用不超1.80億元專項資金用於股權投資業務】朗迪集團8月19日公告， 公司當天召開第八屆董事會第四次會議，審議透過《關於授權管理層對外投資額度的議案》，為提高決策效率，在投資風險可控且不影響公司正常經營的情況下，擬授權管理層使用不超過人民幣1.80億元（關聯交易除外）專項資金用於股權投資業務，其中單項投資金額原則上不超過1億元，使用期限自董事會審議透過之日起12個月內有效，在上述額度及期限內，資金可以滾動使用。上述授權額度及範圍不包括根據相關法律法規及《公司章程》等規定需經董事會或股東會審議批准後方可實施的對外投資事項。

European Stocks Little Changed on Wednesday — European shares were broadly flat on Wednesday as investors remained cautious amid uncertainty in the Middle East and awaited the minutes of the Federal Reserve’s July meeting for further guidance on interest rates. Gains in basic resources stocks, supported by firmer gold prices, provided some stability, with the sector rising around 0.6%. In contrast, technology stocks were the weakest performers, falling about 0.4% as higher bond yields weighed on growth-sensitive shares. Semiconductor stocks also came under pressure after reports that Anthropic’s annual revenue run rate reached $65 billion, falling short of some elevated market expectations. Soitec dropped 4.4%, while Nordic Semiconductor and Scout24 lost more than 2% each. Geopolitical tensions remained in focus after President Donald Trump said there were no ongoing talks with Iran and claimed the Strait of Hormuz was open. Meanwhile, UK inflation accelerated to 2.9% in July from 2.6% in June, exceeding expectations.

India 10Y Yield Eases From Two-Week High — The yield on India’s 10-year G-Sec weakened to around 6.8%, retreating from recent gains as easing US Treasury yields and bargain buying after a two-day selloff supported demand for government bonds. The US 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.686%, offering some relief to Indian debt, while foreign investors continued to show demand, buying $3.04 billion of Indian bonds in July, their second consecutive monthly inflow after India scrapped capital gains tax on interest and sales of government securities for overseas investors. The decline in yields was limited by elevated oil prices and renewed geopolitical risks, with Brent crude rising to around $92 a barrel as uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz persisted. The benchmark bond yield had climbed to a two-week high on Tuesday following the RBI’s early withdrawal of its discounted forex swap facility for banks hedging diaspora deposits. Investors were also awaiting the RBI’s policy minutes for fresh interest-rate cues.

【CLSA: Zhipu GLM-5.3 shows marked capability gains; keeps Outperform, HK$2,061 TP】CLSA says Zhipu AI (02513.HK) has opened API access to GLM‑5.3, which leads domestic peers on complex coding and long‑horizon agent tasks. Despite a smaller parameter count, GLM‑5.3 posts open‑weight SOTA across benchmarks and scores 60 on the Artificial Analysis AI Index—level with Kimi 3 and above Alibaba’s Tongyi Qianwen 3.8 Max. CLSA estimates GLM models’ OpenRouter revenue share rose to 7% in July from 1% in January, ahead of DeepSeek at 6% and Moonshot AI at 3%; it views DeepSeek’s recent price increases as a sign of healthy competition and says GLM‑5.3 has reclaimed the Pareto frontier. CLSA flags that recent stock weakness may reflect an overreaction to slower annualized recurring revenue at Anthropic, and maintains an Outperform rating with a HK$2,061 target price.

Polish Consumer Morale Weakens in August — Poland’s current consumer confidence indicator fell to -11.3 in August 2026, worsening from -10.2 in the previous month. Evaluations of current major purchases deteriorated the most (-4.9 vs -1.6), while expectations for the country’s future economic situation also weakened (-19.3 vs -17.3). Expectations for households’ financial situation over the next 12 months declined (-3.1 vs -2.7), as did assessments of the country’s current economic situation (-23.8 vs -23.4). Meanwhile, households’ financial situation over the last 12 months improved (-5.4 vs -6.0). The leading consumer confidence indicator also deteriorated, falling to -7.6 from -7.3 in July, with expectations for future savings (-14.1 vs 16.3) and the country’s future economic situation (-19.3 vs -17.3) weakening, while expectations for unemployment improved (-22.2 vs -25.3).

He added that the strait is open and operating, in contrast to Iran’s position that the key waterway will remain closed until Washington meets its conditions. Traffic through the waterway has fallen to a standstill, stranding Qatari LNG tankers and delaying deliveries to Europe. As a result, traders are increasingly concerned that Europe could enter the winter heating season with insufficient reserves, keeping upward pressure on gas prices.

【Goldman Sachs: rates shifting from "central bank problem" to "bond supply problem"】Goldman Sachs Delta-one head Rich Privorotsky says current rate pressure is increasingly a bond-supply problem. Recent US data has softened and pushed down short-end yields, but long-end yields remain under pressure as markets must absorb large sovereign deficits and potentially more than $1tln a year of AI-related capex increasingly financed via the debt markets. Privorotsky says markets will need higher real rates to absorb that supply, implying long-term yields may not fall even if growth weakens; the curve could remain split — short end driven by data and central bank policy, long end constrained by fiscal and financing supply. He flags an extreme scenario where a loss of anchoring at the long end forces the Fed to stay tighter amid weak data to flatten the curve and stabilise long-term rate expectations. He identifies the mid-term market’s biggest risk as long-end rates, not the timing of a single rate cut.

The decision came amid concerns about the central bank's independence from political influence following Perry Warjiyo's sudden resignation as BI chief last month and the appointment of Senior Deputy Governor Destry Damayanti as interim chief. The central bank has raised rates by a total of 100 bps since May, bringing the policy rate to its highest level since April 2025 to attract foreign inflows and shore up the rupiah, which has come under pressure. The annual inflation rate eased to 2.88% in July from 3.34% in June, remaining within Bank Indonesia's 1.5%–3.5% target range. 【美要求各方在美中人工智慧生態系統中“選邊站隊”，外交部：堅決反對搞陣營對抗】8月19日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。澎湃新聞（www.thepaper.cn）記者提問，據報道，美政府擬致信“人工智慧機遇夥伴關係聯合宣告”聯署國，要求各方不得同時加入美方相關倡議和與美方倡議衝突的其他機制。美匿名官員稱，此舉旨在向各方明確指出，不得同時加入美中兩國的人工智慧生態系統。中方對此有何評論？林劍表示，人工智慧是全人類共同的智慧結晶和寶貴財富，國際社會普遍期待廣泛開展人工智慧合作。各國有權根據自身的國情和發展需要，選擇合作伙伴。林劍強調，中方堅決反對在人工智慧問題上搞選邊站隊，陣營對抗，希望各方擯棄零和思維，堅持和衷共濟，尊重各國的數字主權，攜手構建公正合理的全球人工智慧治理體系，讓人工智慧成為促進共同繁榮，維護共同安全的重要動力源。

【PBOC 7-day reverse repo zero for seven straight trading days; future market-rate trend "more stable"】On Aug. 19 the PBOC set 7-day reverse repo injections at zero per primary dealers’ demand — the seventh consecutive trading day with no 7-day injections since Aug. 11. The four overnight reverse repo operations previewed on Aug. 12 were all conducted, but daily volumes stayed below the 600 billion yuan cap. Dongfang Jincheng chief macro analyst Wang Qing said liquidity has been relatively ample since Aug. 14, leaving daily overnight reverse repo demand under the cap. From Aug. 14–19, DR001 and DR007 averages ran below the 1.4% policy rate and declined versus earlier levels, which Wang links to August’s lighter fiscal-revenue and tax-payment flows and only mild fiscal-driven cash withdrawals. The PBOC is likely to resume 7-day reverse repos on Aug. 20 to signal the policy rate and stabilise expectations, and to restart overnight reverse repos near month-end — a shift the PBOC says will permit more precise liquidity adjustments and should support DR001 stability.

Austria July Inflation Revised Higher — The inflation rate in Austria eased to 2.8% year-on-year in July 2026 from 3.2% in the previous month, slightly higher than preliminary estimates of a 2.7% increase. This marked the lowest reading in five months, as price growth slowed for alcoholic beverages and tobacco (1.8% vs 2.0% in June), housing utilities (2.7% vs 3.0%), transportation (6.4% vs 6.5%), education (4.9% vs 5.5%), and miscellaneous and services (3.1% vs 4.7%). Moreover, costs fell for food and non-alcoholic beverages (-0.4% vs 1.3%) and clothing and footwear (-0.7% vs 1.8%). Meanwhile, inflation strengthened for health (4.6% vs 4.4%), recreation and culture (1.9% vs 1.0%), and restaurants and hotels (4.6% vs 4.5%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices were unchanged in July, matching the pace in June. The annual harmonised inflation rate (HICP) rose by 2.7%, slowing from 3.2% in the preceding period, and slightly missing initial estimates of 2.6%.

Moldova Producer Prices Fall for 3rd Month — Producer prices in Moldova fell by 0.2% year-on-year in July 2026, following a 0.4% decline in the previous month. This marked the third consecutive month of contraction, driven mainly by a 12.8% decline in prices for electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply, which remained unchanged from June. Meanwhile, mining and quarrying prices increased 7.7%, up from 6.8%, partially offsetting the decline in the overall producer price index. Costs in the manufacturing sector also accelerated (0.9% vs 0.6%), led by stronger price growth for beverages (2.3% vs 1.7%), furniture (0.8% vs 0.5%), and chemicals and chemical products (5.5% vs 2.9%). Prices for basic metals also rose faster (5.4% vs 4.8%). These more than offset slower price growth for food products (1.6% vs 1.9%), rubber and plastic products (0.5% vs 0.7%), and paper products (1.8% vs 2.5%). On a monthly basis, producer prices grew by 0.3% in July, accelerating from a 0.1% gain in June.

【Global bond yields surge; higher rates threaten AI infrastructure economics】U.S. 30-year Treasury yield rose to 5.33% on Tuesday, a 19-year high. Japan's 10-year yield hit a 30-year peak, while German and French 30-year yields climbed to their highest levels since 2011 and 2008. The advance reflects concern about sticky inflation and a growing U.S. debt burden. Market participants say rising yields increase discount rates applied to long-dated AI earnings and raise borrowing costs, pressuring planned data-center investment. State Street Global strategist Batorini said materially higher, persistent yields would hit long-duration growth stocks by lifting discount rates; he noted AI capex starts funded by hyperscalers' cash but shifts toward bond financing over time, raising sensitivity to yield swings. D.A. Davidson tech head Luria said higher borrowing costs will make AI data-center projects harder to launch and will weigh unevenly across the sector: diversified giants such as Microsoft and Amazon can absorb the shock, while more debt-reliant players including CoreWeave and Oracle face larger risk and tighter market scrutiny; for debt-dependent firms, small rate moves could jeopardize expansion plans.

Slovakia Current Account Deficit Narrows in June — Slovakia's current account deficit narrowed to EUR 226.5 million in June 2026 from EUR 277.6 million in the corresponding month of the previous year. In contrast, the services account surplus edged down to EUR 41.3 million from EUR 41.6 million, and the secondary income deficit widened to EUR 104.1 million from EUR 91.7 million. 【A-shares close: ChiNext down 6.26%; over 5,000 stocks fall】A-shares closed sharply lower as risk-off swept the market. Shanghai Composite fell 2.40%, Shenzhen Composite dropped 5.01%, ChiNext plunged 6.26% and the STAR 50 Index fell 6.89%. Turnover across Shanghai and Shenzhen was 2.51 trillion yuan, up more than 110 billion yuan from the prior session. More than 5,000 stocks declined. MLCC names led losses, with Fenghua Hi‑Tech, Boqian New Materials, Jiemei Technology and Torch Electronics hitting lower limits. The CPO cohort tumbled; roughly 20 stocks hit limit down, including Yangtze Optical Fibre, Xingwang Ruijie, Anfu Technology, Tsinghua Unigroup and Tongyu Communication. Humanoid-robot names sold off sharply—Shangwei New Materials fell over 19%, and multiple peers were down more than 15%. Lithography, memory chips, glass-substrate and advanced packaging sectors also underperformed. Banks bucked the selloff: CITIC Bank rose about 4%, while Agricultural Bank of China, Nanjing Bank, Bank of Shanghai and Qingdao Bank gained over 2%. Coal sector remained active, with Baotailong, Shaanxi Heimao, Jinneng Technology, Suda, Dayou Energy and Meijin Energy hitting upper limits. Swiss Industrial Output Rebounds Sharply — Industrial production in Switzerland grew by 5.5% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, defying market expectations for a 4.7% drop and recovering from an upwardly revised 7.6% decline in the previous quarter. The rebound was driven by a strong recovery in manufacturing, which expanded 6.1%, following a 7.7% contraction in Q1, particularly supported by a surge in pharmaceutical production (15.5% vs -21.4%) and stronger output of wood, paper and printing products (5.9% vs -2.0%). Construction activity also accelerated to 2.1% from 0.6%, led by stronger building construction (4.3% vs 3.3%). In contrast, transport equipment production plunged 15.8% (vs 0.8%), while machinery and equipment output fell 5.1% (vs 3.4%). Mining and quarrying output declined 2.9% (vs 3.4%), while electricity supply contracted 2.0% (vs -6.8%). Overall, production in the secondary sector, including construction, increased 5.1% year-on-year, marking a sharp turnaround from the 6.5% contraction in Q1.

【Dollar weakens ahead of Fed minutes】The dollar weakened as investors stayed cautious ahead of the Fed's July minutes. Recent US labor-market weakness and moderate inflation have led markets to scale back expectations for further rate hikes. ASX Extends Slide to 2-Week Low — The ASX 200 lost 16 points, or 0.2%, to close at 9,054 on Wednesday, marking a sixth straight decline and a two-week low. Sentiment remained downbeat as U.S. stock futures weakened, weighed by rising oil prices, elevated Treasury yields, and an extended drop in chip stocks on Wall Street. Locally, Q2 wages in Australia rose 3.2% yoy, unchanged from the prior quarter and the weakest pace in five quarters, while caution built ahead of July labor data due Thursday. Separately, RBA Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser warned cash rates may need to rise again if inflation risks persist, stressing price growth remains “too high.” Tech led losses, followed by consumers, logistics, and financials. Whitehaven Coal tumbled 2.4% on weak earnings, and Evolution Mining shed 0.9% despite stronger FY26 profit. Three of the big four banks eased 0.1%–1.4%. In contrast, Santos gained 2.5% on higher oil prices and an interim dividend aligned with estimates, reflecting its first-half operating free cash flow.

【“木頭姐”談為何不投SK海力士和美光：記憶體價格飛漲是警示訊號】Ark Invest執行長凱茜·伍德表示，她正避免投資依賴記憶體的人工智慧晶片股票，轉而青睞Cerebras Systems和Groq等公司（這兩家公司正在開發無需高頻寬記憶體的AI晶片），並稱記憶體短缺推高價格是警示訊號，而非投資的理由。伍德在一檔播客節目中解釋了為何Ark不持有儲存類股票，認為高頻寬記憶體是半導體產業鏈中最具週期性、最容易商品化的環節。她說，價格上漲三倍、四倍甚至十倍 “並非正常狀態”，應當被視作負面訊號而非利好。伍德將這一現象類比為特斯拉在電池設計中剔除鈷元素，以此規避供應鏈瓶頸，並稱晶片行業如今正 “透過技術設計擺脫對高頻寬記憶體的依賴”。

【星動紀元物流機器人現場揀快遞，最快2000件/小時】今日，世界機器人大會（WRC 2026）於北京北人亦創國際會展中心開幕。開展首日，星動紀元研發的物流分揀具身機器人上演了高效分揀快遞的一幕。在勻速執行的快遞傳送帶上，機器人能夠自主識別不同規格、大小、材質和重量的快遞包裹，高效完成抓取、翻面、放置到傳送帶等一系列供包作業。“這款機器人目前分揀快遞的速度能達到1200件/小時，內部極限測試能夠達到2000件/小時。”現場人員表示。（新浪科技）

【華福證券：維持今世緣“買入”評級，經營及盈利趨勢有望進一步向上】華福證券研報指出，今世緣邊際改善，企穩初顯。上半年實現歸母淨利潤20.82億元，同比-6.60%；單Q2實現歸母淨利潤6.97億元，同比+19.17%。經營資料呈現明顯的邊際改善特徵。公司產品矩陣清晰。分品牌運作持續完善。深耕品牌分層，國緣V系列深耕高階圈層守護品牌價值；國緣開系鎖定江蘇300-600元主流價格帶守住市場份額；國緣淡雅深化消費者溝通實現持續放量；今世緣聚焦喜慶品牌標籤穩住基本盤；高溝品牌以正能量人文內容塑造品牌“標樣精神”。公司總體上堅持省內夯實基本盤、省外培育新增長極、新興渠道補充增量的思路，市場攻堅有序推進。公司憑藉自身向上的品牌勢能、逐步精細化的運營體系、以及前期主動調整的基礎，正明顯走向企穩修復狀態。隨著下半年消費需求的改善，公司經營及盈利趨勢有望進一步向上，維持“買入”評級。

【巴克萊策略師上調歐洲全年盈利預期】巴克萊策略師目前預測，2026年歐洲企業盈利將大增16%，此前預期為12%，理由是預計下半年盈利增長動能將增強。由馬格什・庫馬爾・錢德拉塞卡蘭與埃馬紐埃爾・考領銜的團隊表示，分析師上調盈利預期的節奏正向美國靠攏，各行業盈利改善的覆蓋面也在擴大。“名義經濟增長走高仍是歐洲企業盈利的重要利好，油價形成支撐，匯率也轉為小幅利好因素。”但他們同時警示，能源價格仍是一大不確定變數，滯脹風險可能會令盈利預估承壓。

【BofA: Optimism toward Europe back at pre-Iran-war highs】BofA says a surge in AI-driven capex and a stronger economic outlook have tilted investor preference toward European equities over US names. Its survey found ~47% of fund managers expect European stocks to slightly outperform US stocks over the next 12 months — the highest since February when the Iran war began. About 97% of respondents expect Europe to avoid recession, the strongest reading since 2007. More than three-quarters said further equity gains would be driven mainly by upward revisions to corporate earnings. BofA strategist Andreas Bruckner said the bank is refocusing on pro‑Europe themes that were temporarily stalled by the Iran war.

【極端高溫成常態，韓國首爾計劃到2028年將所有人行道改造成遮陽步道】韓國首爾市政府週三公佈一項大規模城市建設計劃，到2028年將全市所有人行道上改造成連續的遮陽步道，以應對極端高溫天氣。首爾市長吳世勳在新聞釋出會上公佈了這項政策，保障市民擁有 “在遮陰街道行走的權利”，並著重強調該問題的緊迫性。“熱浪已不再只是幾天後就會消失的短暫不適，”吳世勳表示，“隨著其強度增強和持續時間延長，它們已成為威脅市民生命與安全的日常災難。”工程完工後，遮陽步道將連通居民區、地鐵站、學校、集市、醫院以及公園。完成效果評估後，這套遮陽步行網路將於 2028 年在全市鋪開。

【嘉士伯上半年營收增2.6%，上調全年盈利指引】嘉士伯8月19日釋出2026年上半年財報。集團上半年營收同比增長2.6%至470.53億丹麥克朗，營業利潤增長4.5%至74.48億丹麥克朗，淨利潤增長6.0%至42.88億丹麥克朗。嘉士伯將2026年有機營業利潤增長預期由此前的2%-6%收窄至4%-6%，向此前指引區間上限靠攏。

【今年第18號颱風“沙德爾”生成 未來5天對我國海域無影響】今年第18號颱風“沙德爾”（熱帶風暴級）已於今天（8月19日）上午在西北太平洋洋麵上生成，11點鐘其中心位於美國關島東南方向約1160公里的洋麵上，就是北緯8.2度、東經153.9度，中心附近最大風力有8級（18米/秒），中心最低氣壓為998百帕，七級風圈半徑為100~200公里。預計，“沙德爾”將以每小時15~20公里的速度向北偏西方向移動，強度逐漸增強，趨向琉球群島以東洋麵，未來5天對我國海域無影響。

【美銀：印度股市取代印尼，成為亞洲最不受歡迎的股市】美國銀行對基金經理進行的一項調查顯示，印度股市取代印尼股市，成為亞洲最不受歡迎的股市。這表明，投資者對印度股市的謹慎情緒日益增長，該市場是今年全球表現最差的市場之一。調查顯示，缺乏明確的AI敞口仍是印度股市面臨的首要擔憂，疲弱的經濟增長則成為第二大風險。調查中有32%的受訪者對印度股票持淨低配立場。缺乏改革以及估值高企，也成為投資者看空這個亞洲第四大股票市場的原因。相比之下，投資者對印度尼西亞的情緒有所改善，27%的基金經理表示對該市場持淨低配立場，低於7月的32%。

【BofA: India equities overtake Indonesia as Asia's most-unloved market】A BofA survey of fund managers shows India has replaced Indonesia as Asia's most-unloved equity market, underscoring rising investor caution; India is among this year's worst-performing markets globally. Respondents cited lack of clear AI exposure as the top concern, followed by weak economic growth. 32% of managers report being net underweight India equities, citing high valuations and a lack of reforms. Sentiment on Indonesia improved: 27% are net underweight there, down from 32% in July.

【衣索比亞央行大量消耗美元儲備以阻止貨幣貶值】今年以來，衣索比亞央行已投入22億美元捍衛持續下跌的貨幣比爾，上週的干預行動更是吸引了四倍於出價的買盤。然而，由於高油價給衣索比亞經濟帶來日益沉重的壓力，這些措施仍不足以阻止比爾的持續貶值。比爾今年已貶值3.2%，跌至近1美元兌162比爾的歷史新低，是過去一年非洲表現最差的貨幣之一。而伊朗衝突進一步打破了市場對其企穩的希望。衝突推高了燃料和化肥進口成本，同時減少了海灣地區務工人員的匯款。渣打銀行非洲經濟學家Sarah Baynton-Glen表示：“外匯短缺是由結構性經常賬戶赤字造成的。”衣索比亞是石油進口國，因此油價上漲時，比爾“往往會面臨更大的貶值壓力”。

【韓方稱事前不知特朗普縮減聯合軍演的表態】據韓聯社19日報道，韓國外交部長官趙顯和國防部長官安圭伯當天表示，韓國政府事前不知美國總統特朗普會發表有關縮減韓美聯合軍演的表態。 特朗普16日在社交媒體發文說，他已要求美國防部大幅縮減美韓聯合軍演規模。他稱，這些軍演“耗資巨大”，其中很大一部分由美國負擔，同時對朝鮮釋放出“完全不恰當和敵對的訊號”。 趙顯19日在韓國國會上就此回應說，就特朗普此前在社交媒體上釋出的相關內容，韓國政府和美國政府相關人士事前完全不知情。韓方事前並沒有接到相關通知。安圭伯同日也就此回應說，對於特朗普在社交媒體上釋出的相關內容，韓美政府相關人士事前完全不知情。 針對縮減韓美聯合軍演規模是否會影響到戰時作戰指揮權的移交，趙顯表示，此次縮減實際上是應美方要求進行的，因此美方不能以此為由推遲移交指揮權。 韓國聯合參謀本部19日表示，原定於17日至27日舉行的韓美“乙支自由之盾”聯合軍演將提前6天於21日結束，日程縮短過半。(新華社)

【機構：預計第三季度DRAM現貨銷量將保持低迷 DDR4價格本週上漲0.67%】根據TrendForce最新發布的記憶體現貨價格趨勢報告，DRAM現貨市場供需依然疲軟，預計2026年第三季度交易量將保持低位，而價格將繼續小幅上漲，主流晶片（例如DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s）的平均現貨價格已從上週（8月12日）的42.61美元上漲至本週（8月18日）的42.90美元，漲幅為0.67%。NAND快閃記憶體方面，交易勢頭持續減弱，本週512Gb TLC晶圓現貨價格上漲0.39%，達到每片21.208美元。

【UBS: Baidu (09888.HK) Q2 AI cloud growth slows; demand healthy, PT cut to HK$155】UBS said Baidu's Q2 results were weak. AI cloud infrastructure revenue rose 50% YoY, down from 79% in Q1; UBS attributes the slowdown to revenue-recognition timing but says compute demand for AI training and inference remains healthy. UBS now expects H2 growth to reaccelerate above 60% as existing clients boost spending and the customer base expands, and has slightly raised its H2 AI cloud infrastructure growth forecast to >60%. The bank trimmed H2 core operating profit forecasts by 6% to reflect higher R&D spending, left full-year core revenue broadly unchanged, cut full-year non-GAAP net profit by 27%, lowered its target price to HK$155 (from HK$165) and kept a Buy rating.

【Ethiopia central bank draws down $2.2bn in reserves to defend birr】Ethiopia's central bank has spent $2.2bn this year defending the sliding birr; last week's intervention drew bids about four times the amount offered. The measures have not halted depreciation: the birr is down 3.2% YTD and hit a record low near 162 per USD, making it one of Africa's weakest currencies over the past year. Rising oil prices and the Iran conflict have pushed up fuel and fertilizer import costs and cut remittances from Gulf workers, adding pressure on external balances. Standard Chartered Africa economist Sarah Baynton-Glen said the FX shortfall is driven by a structural current account deficit. As an oil importer, Ethiopia typically sees greater depreciation pressure on the birr when oil prices rise.
【日本大飯核電站3號機組公佈發電機異常原因為勵磁機部件損壞】日本關西電力公司和福井縣政府方面19日釋出訊息稱，關西電力大飯核電站3號機組8日發生的發電機和反應堆自動停機，原因是勵磁機部件發生損壞。據福井縣介紹，勵磁機內部共有72個二極體部件，其中1個二極體的固定螺栓發生斷裂。附近還發現了因高溫熔化留下的痕跡。發電機本身沒有發現異常。（央視新聞）

UK Producer Inflation at 4-Month Low of 3.1% — Factory gate prices for UK-manufactured goods advanced 3.1% year-on-year in July 2026, slowing from a 3.5% growth in June, marking the softest increase in four months. Eight of the 10 product groups made upward contributions to the annual rate, led by a jump in prices of coke and refined petroleum products (30.1% vs 41.3% in June) amid higher energy costs. Inflation accelerated for other manufactured products (4.6% vs 4.5% in June) and basic metals, fabricated metal products, and machinery (5.0% vs 5.2%). Meanwhile, motor vehicles and other transport equipment made the largest downward contribution, with prices declining 1.6%, followed by food products, where prices fell 0.8%. On a monthly basis, factory gate prices rose 0.2%, after inching down 0.1% in June.

UK Core Inflation Holds at 2.6% for Third Month — The UK's annual core inflation rate remained at 2.6% in July 2026, unchanged for the third consecutive month. It stayed at its highest level since March and slightly above market expectations of 2.5%. The annual rate for CPI goods accelerated (2.2% vs 1.7% in June), while CPI services inflation eased (3.4% vs 3.6%). 【Top private funds lift equity exposure above 88% amid buy-the-dip activity】As of Aug 14 the equity private‑fund exposure index stood at 83.97%, up marginally week‑on‑week. 70.39% of equity private funds are >80% invested; 17.87% at 50–80%; 7.75% at 20–50%; 3.99% below 20%. Positioning shows clear buy‑the‑dip behavior: during July’s sharp tech sell‑off managers increased exposure for five consecutive weeks, rising from 82.0% on June 26 to a year‑to‑date peak of 84.53% on July 31. After a strong market rebound in the first week of August funds slowed adding and exposure fell to 83.88%, but positions ticked up again in the second week as volatility resumed, led by large private‑fund buying.

UK Inflation Rises to 4-Month High — The annual inflation rate in the UK rose to 2.9% in July 2026, the highest in four months, from 2.6% in June and in line with market expectations. The largest upward contribution came from housing and household services (4.1% vs 2.7% in June), particularly gas and electricity. Prices of furniture and household goods (1% vs -0.2%) and clothing and footwear rebounded (0.5% vs -0.5%). On a monthly basis, the CPI increased 0.3%, following a 0.1% rise in the previous month.

【TSMC CoWoS capacity oversubscribed】Reportedly TSMC’s advanced-packaging CoWoS capacity is oversubscribed and orders are fully booked. Some back-end advanced-packaging orders have spilled to an Intel-owned Malaysia plant under partial capacity-sharing to serve common major customers, breaking prior ecosystem norms. Market participants say the overflow should free front-end advanced-node capacity and accelerate TSMC node shipments. Suppliers overlapping both players’ chains — including ASE Technology Holding, substrate leader Unimicron Technology and other packaging groups — are expected to benefit. Industry sources on Aug. 18 said the global advanced-packaging bottleneck is that back-end ramp rates lag front-end output; more back-end suppliers joining capacity would help speed front-end deliveries.

【US share of Indian exports steady at ~20% despite Trump tariffs】Analysis of India’s commerce ministry data shows the US accounted for roughly 20% of Indian exports in the 12 months to July, largely unchanged despite a year of punitive tariffs imposed by US president Trump. US duties on Indian goods peaked at around 50% before being reduced to 18% in February and currently sit at 10%. India has pursued trade diversification through new agreements with other partners, but no bilateral trade deal with the US has been signed after months of high-level talks.

【工信部：將推動機器人產業聚焦2個關鍵環節、4個重點行業】據央廣網，8月19日，在2026世界機器人大會開幕式上，工業和資訊化部副部長辛國斌在致辭中介紹，2025年，機器人產業規模以上企業營業收入突破3000億元，近五年年均增速超20%；今年上半年達到1655億元，同比增長24.5%。辛國斌指出，當前，全球人工智慧技術創新空前活躍。智慧機器人作為人工智慧從數字世界走向物理世界的重要載體，正在以前所未有的速度賦能千行百業、走進千家萬戶。但也要清醒看到，智慧機器人產業發展仍面臨不少挑戰，智慧化水平不高、技能作業能力不強等問題較為突出。2026年是中國“十五五”規劃的開局之年。辛國斌表示，站在新的歷史起點上，工業和資訊化部將深入貫徹落實黨中央、國務院決策部署，緊緊把握“十五五”發展機遇，以智慧化為主線，以實用化為牽引，統籌技術攻關、產業培育、場景拓展與安全治理，推動機器人產業創新發展。將聚焦核心零部件、具身智慧等關鍵環節，打通產學研用創新鏈條。鼓勵中外科研機構、企業開展聯合攻關，打造一批先進、適用、易用的智慧機器人標誌性產品。將聚焦農業、醫療、養老、應急等應用空間廣、示範效應強的重點行業，分類組織開展產用結對攻關、實地應用驗證和成熟場景推廣，以新場景大規模應用加速新技術新產品迭代升級。同時，在推動機器人技術產業向前發展的同時，注重推動技術向善、科技為民，讓機器人更好服務人的生產生活，兼顧效率提升與就業保障，實現技術進步與人的發展相得益彰。

【殷勇：上半年北京市工業機器人、服務機器人產量分別增長76%和2.3倍】8月19日，2026世界機器人大會在京開幕。北京市市長殷勇在致辭中介紹，北京設立100億的機器人領域高精尖產業投資基金，已經帶動社會資本投入超過530億元。目前北京市擁有機器人企業近千家，7傢俱身智慧企業新晉獨角獸，數量居全國首位。殷勇指出，北京已建設具身智慧機器人創新中心和5家新型的研發機構，匯聚各類創新主體力量，強化核心技術攻關，在機器人本體、開源大腦、靈巧手等領域湧現出一大批標誌性的技術和產品。全面佈局14種人形機器人關鍵部件組成，建成年產能2萬臺的整機代工生產線。今年上半年工業機器人、服務機器人產量分別增長76%和2.3倍。殷勇表示，在各國家部委等的大力支援下，北京打造了世界機器人大會、世界人形機器人運動會、人形機器人半程馬拉松等“兩會一賽”的重要平臺。北京正是以這些標誌性的活動，引領行業規則的制定和標準的定義，機器人領域九成以上的國家標準由北京創新主體牽頭和參與編寫。（央廣網）

NZX 50 Ends 0.5% Higher on Earnings Results Boost — New Zealand's stocks rose 63 points, or 0.5%, to close at 13,930 on Wednesday, marking their highest level since August 6 and extending gains from the previous session, mainly buoyed by gains in healthcare and communication services. However, a downbeat session on Wall Street overnight, due to a selloff in chipmaker-related stocks, rising Treasury yields, and higher oil prices, capped gains. On the data front, New Zealand's input and output prices rose 2.9% and 1.6%, respectively, quarter-on-quarter in Q2, marking the fastest increases since Q1 2025. 【Goldman Sachs desk head: AI capex may top $1trn, crowding out non-AI economy】Goldman Sachs Delta-One desk head Rich Privorotsky warned global capital is being heavily absorbed by government financing and AI infrastructure investment. He expects annual AI capex could exceed $1 trillion and become increasingly debt-financed. With major economies still running large fiscal deficits, public spending and AI are drawing on the same capital pool, a squeeze already transmitting to the non-AI economy. Governments typically lack incentives to cut spending, so higher real rates may force more adjustment onto the private sector. Privorotsky cites large-cap re-rating as evidence—stock price action has lagged what EPS revisions alone would explain. On demand, he says fiscal stimulus was largely front-loaded, tariff-driven inventory rebuilds are mostly complete and some demand was pulled forward. As more funds flow to data centres and AI infrastructure, financing, investment and valuations in non-AI sectors could remain under pressure and market dispersion widen.

【AI需求推動，韓國上市公司上半年合併營業利潤同比飆升近350%】週三公佈的資料顯示，今年上半年，韓國上市企業實現了創紀錄的盈利，主要受全球對人工智慧所用半導體的旺盛需求拉動。 根據韓國交易所釋出的資料，在1月至6月期間，韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）成分股上市公司720家企業的合併營業利潤同比增長348.5%，達到275萬億韓元（約合1952億美元）。其合併營收同比增長34.5%，達1070萬億韓元，淨利潤則飆升330%，達到2915萬億韓元。

【日元波動加劇後套利交易降溫 瑞郎成主要替代融資貨幣】隨著干預風險和利率上升削弱了借入日元的吸引力，套利交易者短期內正越來越多地將瑞士法郎作為融資來源。根據美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)最新資料，截至8月11日當週，對沖基金將瑞郎淨空頭頭寸增至接近兩個月高位。與此同時，它們連續第二週削減日元空頭頭寸。以瑞士法郎借款的吸引力，一方面源於瑞士利率接近零，另一方面也得益於瑞士央行遏制本幣升值的意願。相比之下，自7月下旬日本和美國出手干預以提振日元匯率、推高日元波動率以來，投資者對以日元融資的套利交易愈發謹慎。知情人士上週表示，日本政府支援日本央行在短期內加息。

【China foreign minister Wang Yi meets Chile foreign minister Pérez】On Aug 19, 2026 in Beijing, China foreign minister Wang Yi met Chile foreign minister Pérez. 【王毅同智利外長佩雷斯會談】8月19日，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅在北京同智利外長佩雷斯舉行會談。王毅說，中智傳統友誼源遠流長，是隔洋相望的好朋友、好夥伴。智利是首個同新中國建交的南美國家，也是第一個同中國簽署自由貿易協定的拉美國家，在發展對華關係上超越黨派異同，始終走在拉美和加勒比國家前列。中智關係發展最重要的經驗在於雙方奉行獨立自主外交政策，堅持相互尊重、平等相待，堅持優勢互補、互利共贏。今年是中智建立全面戰略伙伴關係10週年，中方願同智新政府一道，賡續傳統友誼，深化務實合作，推動中智關係邁上新臺階。王毅表示，中智雙方要保持各層級交往，鞏固高水平互信，繼續在涉及彼此核心利益問題上相互支援。中方願同智方圍繞APEC“中國年”深化合作，加快亞太共同體和亞太自貿區建設。雙方要加強發展戰略對接，穩步推進既有合作專案，深挖人工智慧、數字經濟等領域合作潛力，推動合作提質升級。要增進溝通協作，共同倡導和踐行真正的多邊主義，維護以聯合國為核心的國際體系，為世界和平與發展發揮建設性作用，推動構建人類命運共同體。（外交部）

【Yen volatility rises, investors shift to Swiss franc-funded carry trades】Rising intervention risk and higher rates have weakened yen funding, pushing carry traders toward Swiss franc financing. CFTC data for the week to Aug. 11 show hedge funds’ net short positions in the franc near a two-month high while they trimmed yen shorts for a second consecutive week. Tobias Jungmann, head of FX options at BofA in New York, said markets have increased franc short exposure to finance FX carry trades and that options are attractive given the franc’s vol-to-carry profile, allowing exposure with capped downside. The franc’s appeal rests on near-zero Swiss interest rates and the Swiss National Bank’s willingness to limit appreciation; by contrast, a late-July Japan–U.S. joint intervention raised yen volatility and curbed yen-funded trades.

【18th typhoon Shadol forms; no impact on Chinese waters over next five days】China’s Central Meteorological Observatory said at 12:34 on Aug. 19 that Typhoon No.18, Shadol, formed in the northwest Pacific. At 11:00 the centre was at 8.2°N, 153.9°E, about 1,160 km southeast of Guam. Maximum winds near the centre were 18 m/s, central pressure 998 hPa, with a radius of gale-force (≥7) winds of 100–200 km. Shadol is moving NNW at 15–20 km/h, expected to strengthen and track toward waters east of the Ryukyu Islands; no impact on Chinese waters is expected over the next five days.

【北京火箭大街商業航天智慧測運控中心正式啟用】據“北京亦莊”公眾號訊息，8月19日，朱雀三號重複使用運載火箭在東風商業航天創新試驗區成功將“鴻鵠03星”送入預定軌道，並完成我國首次運載火箭一子級陸地支腿回收。在距離發射場1000多公里的北京亦莊，全國首個開放式商業航天測運控共享平臺——北京火箭大街商業航天智慧測運控中心於當天正式啟用，並開展了此次歷史性發射任務的全過程星、箭測控，實現了“亦莊箭、亦莊星、亦莊測”。北京火箭大街商業航天智慧測運控中心由北京亦莊企業航天長征火箭技術有限公司建設，是北京經開區重點打造的北京火箭大街六大共性服務平臺之一。中心面向全球提供商業航天測運控服務，覆蓋低軌、高軌、地月空間，具備每年不低於200次商業火箭發射/回收測控、不低於5000顆商業衛星的測運控服務能力。

【嫦娥七號器箭組合體完成垂直轉運 】8月19日上午，嫦娥七號探測器和長征五號遙十四運載火箭在中國文昌航天發射場完成技術區相關工作，器箭組合體垂直轉運至發射區。據中國載人航天工程辦公室介紹，嫦娥七號探測器、長征五號遙十四運載火箭分別於4月、7月運抵發射場，先後完成了總裝、測試等準備工作。目前，發射場設施裝置狀態良好，後續將按計劃開展發射前各項功能檢查、聯合測試、推進劑加註等工作，計劃近日擇機實施發射。

【Jiangsu issues 'AI+' industrial software action plan (2026–28)】The Jiangsu Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology issued the Jiangsu "AI+" Industrial Software Breakthrough Development Action Plan for 2026–2028, outlining five priority tracks: building industrial software development capacity, upgrading software vendors with AI, using industrial software to empower manufacturing, cultivating innovation carriers, and optimizing the industrial-software ecosystem. Key measures include targeted R&D on core underlying AI+ industrial software technologies and tighter integration of AI capabilities into industrial software; development of new service formats—model-as-a-service, agent-as-a-service and outcome-as-a-service—and promotion of result-based and usage-based billing models; construction of high-quality industrial datasets and data–model co‑optimization; accelerated establishment of industrial software research institutes and local innovation centres for pilot testing, compatibility/adaptation and application promotion; and incentives such as compute, model and token vouchers to lower barriers to enterprise AI adoption.

【第18號颱風沙德爾生成 未來5天對我國海域無影響】8月19日12時34分，中央氣象臺介紹，今年第18號颱風“沙德爾”（熱帶風暴級；英文名稱：Saudel；名字來源：密克羅尼西亞；名稱意義：密克羅尼西亞波納佩島（Pohnpei）傳說中的將領“蘇迪羅”信任的衛兵）已於今天（19日）上午在西北太平洋洋麵上生成，11點鐘其中心位於美國關島東南方向約1160公里的洋麵上，就是北緯8.2度、東經153.9度，中心附近最大風力有8級（18米/秒），中心最低氣壓為998百帕，七級風圈半徑為100-200公里。 預計，“沙德爾”將以每小時15-20公里的速度向北偏西方向移動，強度逐漸增強，趨向琉球群島以東洋麵，未來5天對我國海域無影響。

【繞開海峽 伊拉克批准原油出口新機制】伊拉克政府18日說，伊政府已批准相關機制，允許透過專業的國際和本地公司，經過多個口岸出口原油。路透社援引伊拉克政府宣告報道，新出口機制下的合同自9月1日起生效，期限為3個月。伊拉克政府尚未公佈入選公司、該機制下計劃出口原油的數量以及出口口岸等具體細節。今年2月底伊朗戰事爆發前，伊拉克日均原油產量約400萬桶，月均出口約1.05億桶，其中大部分從伊南部巴士拉石油終端、經霍爾木茲海峽外運。霍爾木茲海峽通行受阻後，伊拉克為減少對海灣航線的依賴，加大開發包括途經土耳其和敘利亞的替代出口路線。

【河南擁有12個國家區域醫療中心 數量居全國首位】河南目前已獲批 12個國家區域醫療中心，專案數量穩居全國首位。這些醫療中心對接北京、上海等地的頂尖國家級醫院，涵蓋心血管、腫瘤、兒童、中醫等多個重點專業，讓群眾在家門口就能看好大病、重病。（河南日報）

【安徽九華山旅遊發展股份有限公司原黨委委員、副總經理何龍被“雙開”】日前，經池州市紀委監委指定管轄，青陽縣紀委監委對安徽九華山旅遊發展股份有限公司原黨委委員、副總經理何龍嚴重違紀違法問題進行了立案審查調查。經查，何龍喪失理想信念，背棄初心使命，對黨不忠誠不老實，與他人串供，對抗組織審查；無視中央八項規定精神，違規收受禮品；廉潔底線失守，違規從事營利活動，將應由本人支付的費用交由他人支付；不正確履行工作職責；利用職務便利侵吞公款；利用與國家工作人員的密切關係，透過國家工作人員職務上的行為，為他人謀取不正當利益，並非法收受他人財物；為謀取不正當利益給予國家工作人員財物。何龍嚴重違反黨的政治紀律、廉潔紀律、工作紀律，構成嚴重職務違法並涉嫌貪汙犯罪、利用影響力受賄犯罪、行賄犯罪，且在黨的十八大後不收斂、不收手，性質嚴重，影響惡劣，應予嚴肅處理。依據《中國共產黨紀律處分條例》《中華人民共和國監察法》《中華人民共和國公職人員政務處分法》等有關規定，經池州市財政局（國資委）黨委會議研究，決定給予何龍開除黨籍處分；由池州市國資委給予何龍開除公職處分；收繳其違紀違法所得。由青陽縣監委將其涉嫌犯罪問題移送檢察機關依法審查起訴，所涉財物一併移送。

【東方證券董事長周磊一行來訪上海清算所並調研】據上海清算所訊息，8月18日，東方證券董事長周磊一行來訪上海清算所並調研。雙方圍繞更好服務金融市場高水平對外開放、加強集中清算業務拓展、推動碳金融和場外大宗商品市場建設等議題進行深入交流。雙方一致表示，將進一步提升利率互換、信用衍生品、大宗商品等業務合作的深度與廣度，著力深挖玉蘭發行模式和自貿離岸債、金融債發行與承銷，以及債券、外匯等集中清算業務潛能。
【以色列為空襲敘機場辯解 土耳其予以駁斥 】以色列總理辦公室18日晚發表宣告，證實以軍當天襲擊敘利亞一處空軍基地，並指責敘利亞允許土耳其在敘部署軍隊對以色列構成威脅。土耳其方面19日駁斥說，以方說辭旨在“合法化”對敘空襲。以總理辦公室在宣告中說，以敘已同意在安全問題上“維持現狀”，但敘利亞意圖違反上述原則，允許土耳其軍隊部署在敘利亞阿勒頗附近一處空軍基地。以色列已就此多次警告敘利亞。

【Morgan Stanley downgrades Baidu to Reduce, cuts target to $80】Morgan Stanley downgraded Baidu (BIDU.O) to Reduce from In Line with the market and cut its US target price to $80 from $130, a 38.5% reduction equivalent to a 2027 forecast P/E of 10x. The firm trimmed Baidu’s core revenue forecasts for 2026–28 by 1%–9% and lowered non‑GAAP operating profit estimates by 6%–31%, citing softer revenue and higher AI investment.

【江蘇省出臺“人工智慧+”工業軟體行動方案】江蘇省工信廳近日印發《江蘇省“人工智慧+”工業軟體突破發展行動方案（2026—2028年）》，明確提出緊扣工業軟體智慧化變革需求，推動人工智慧技術深度嵌入工業軟體各環節，實現全領域能力躍升、全流程提質增效。《行動方案》提出，實施工業軟體開發能力築基、工業軟體企業智慧化提升、工業軟體賦能製造業、工業軟體創新載體培育、工業軟體生態最佳化等五大行動。具體包括聚焦“人工智慧+”工業軟體底層核心技術開展攻關，推進工業軟體與人工智慧能力融合；發展“模型即服務”“智慧體即服務”“結果即服務”等新業態，培育按結果付費、按用量計費等新模式，加快工業軟體服務和商業模式創新；推動高質量工業資料集建設，促進資料與模型協同最佳化；加快建設工業軟體研究院，推動各地因地制宜建設創新中心、中試驗證、相容適配、應用推廣等各類創新平臺；鼓勵透過發放算力券、模型券、詞元券等方式，降低企業人工智慧應用門檻。支援設立工業軟體天使基金，用好有關專項資金保障關鍵技術攻關、模型和智慧體培育、企業智慧化升級、創新載體建設。深化人工智慧學院和工業軟體學院建設，鼓勵校企合作共建人才實訓基地。

【新加坡承諾對基金經理實施稅收豁免】新加坡承諾向對沖基金交易員等個人基金管理人提供潛在豐厚的稅收豁免。新加坡金融管理局於週三公佈一系列舉措，提升本國對資產管理行業的吸引力。核心舉措為擬對基金管理人及投資專業人士為合資格基金投資者創造 “優異回報” 所取得的部分利潤予以免稅，該政策對標香港擬實施的附帶收益減稅方案。稅收豁免將適用於本自然年度產生的收入，新加坡金融管理局副主席徐芳達表示，更多細節將在 2027 年新加坡財政預算案中公佈，該預算案通常於每年 2 月前後釋出。

【MORGAN STANLEY: Xiaomi Q2 smartphone margin surprise, sees H2 resilience】MORGAN STANLEY says Xiaomi Group (01810.HK) reported Q2 adjusted net profit of RMB 6.219 billion, down 43% YoY and up 2% QoQ. Smartphone revenue and gross margin materially beat the bank's expectations; electric vehicle and IoT revenue slightly missed. Management said storage price rises should normalize in H2, which would lessen the negative impact on handset margins. MORGAN STANLEY expects smartphone gross margins to remain resilient in H2 and views this as a potential positive surprise and re-rating catalyst. Firm maintains Overweight rating and HK$32 target price.

【海陸回收雙成功！中國重複使用火箭接連命中“靶心”】今天（8月19日），朱雀三號遙二火箭成功發射，一子級實現我國首次陸地可控回收。繼7月10日長征十號乙運載火箭一子級完成海上網系回收之後，中國火箭接連取得海、陸回收雙突破。隨著長征十號乙、朱雀三號可重複使用技術的突破，下一步，國家航天局將持續推進我國重複使用運載火箭工程化應用，切實提升我國大運力、低成本、高頻次進入空間能力。中國航天有望走出一條低成本、高效率的可持續發展路徑。（央視）
【江蘇光伏裝機規模在全國率先破億千瓦 超越煤電晉級“第一大電源”】從國網江蘇省電力有限公司獲悉，截至當日，江蘇省光伏發電累計裝機容量突破1億千瓦、達10008萬千瓦，標誌著江蘇成為我國首個光伏裝機規模破億千瓦省份；同時，光伏裝機佔全省發電總裝機約38%，光伏超過煤電、燃機和風電等，成為江蘇第一大電源。

【Iran says countries without U.S. bases are safer】In an interview broadcast Aug. 18, Iran's foreign minister Araghchi said recent military clashes involving Iran, the U.S. and Israel demonstrate that reliance on external forces and bases cannot guarantee Gulf states' security. He said the presence of U.S. troops and bases not only fails to provide security but is a destabilising factor, and that countries without U.S. bases are safer. Araghchi added Iran is not seeking only a ceasefire but a complete end to the war, and does not want a cycle of short truces followed by renewed fighting.
【全球首款 工業母機具身智慧模型在常州投產驗證】據常州釋出，8月18日，創造力（常州）機器人有限公司在武進國家高新區正式投產，同步宣佈全球首款面向工業母機應用場景的具身智慧模型進入驗證應用階段。該專案由創造力（上海）智慧科技、智元創新（上海）科技股份有限公司及常州國資創投平臺聯合組建。

【伊朗稱沒有美軍基地的國家更安全 】伊朗外長阿拉格齊在8月18日播出的採訪中表示，近期伊朗與美以之間的軍事衝突證明，依賴外部軍事力量和基地無法保障海灣國家的安全。阿拉格齊指出，美國軍隊及軍事基地的存在不僅無法為相關國家提供安全保障，反而成為了破壞安全的因素，沒有美軍基地的國家反而更安全。阿拉格齊還表示，伊朗並不尋求只停火，而是希望徹底結束戰爭，不希望再陷入短暫停火到再次開戰的迴圈。
【從“無人管”到“市場化” 北京老舊小區物業服務全覆蓋加速推進】2025年起，北京市啟動老舊小區物業服務全覆蓋三年行動，提出力爭推動1800多個老舊小區實現物業服務全覆蓋。去年，已有380個老舊小區完成物業覆蓋，今年會再有不少於800個老舊小區引入物業服務。（央視）
【保誠將擴充太古坊香港總部辦公空間】根據新聞公告，保誠和太古地產簽署租賃協議，將位於太古坊的總辦公樓面面積將增至約83,000平方英尺。作為其香港業務擴充套件計劃的一部分，保誠將擴充並整合公司營運至太古坊一座及港島東中心。

【HSBC: Bank of Japan may hike in September to support yen】HSBC Asia FX research head Joey Chew said renewed yen weakness could prompt a hawkish Bank of Japan hike at the September meeting to shore up the currency. Markets price roughly 80bp of BOJ tightening over the next 12 months to about a 1.8% policy rate; HSBC's economics team now expects two further hikes—in September and Q1 2027—taking the policy rate to 1.5% (up from a prior view of a single December hike). Chew said a sustained yen recovery depends on more attractive real rates, easing fiscal concerns and Japanese residents shifting assets from overseas into domestic markets.
